sections.title: 购物
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
46
话题 42
PART 1
购物
Shopping
回答思路：购物题先分清购买必需品与闲逛的不同感受。线上和线下各选适合的商品作比较，价格题则关注质量与使
用次数。退货经历按问题、操作、结果展开即可。回答选择困难时说明卡在哪里，例如尺码不明或同类商品太多。
1. Do you enjoy going shopping?
你喜欢购物吗？ 分开买必需品和随便逛的体验，用一类商品解释自己的兴趣。
I enjoy it when I'm looking for something specific, like a new notebook or a birthday present. Wandering around
crowded shops for hours isn't really my thing. Once I've found what I need, I'm usually ready to go home.
要买特定东西时，我喜欢，比如新笔记本或生日礼物。连续几小时在拥挤的店里闲逛不是我的爱好。一旦找到需要的东西，
我通常就想回家了。
2. How frequently do you shop?
你多久购物一次？ 区分生活采购与衣物购买频率，并交代一次集中购物的内容。
I buy groceries once or twice a week, usually on my way home. Clothes and other things are much less frequent. I
prefer making one planned trip with a short list instead of popping into shops every single day.
我每周买一两次食品，通常顺路带回家。衣服等东西买得少得多。我更喜欢列个短清单，有计划地一次买好，而不是每天
都进商店。
3. Would you rather shop online or visit physical shops?
你更喜欢网购还是去实体店购物？ 给出主要偏好，再用需要试穿的商品说明偏好并非适用一切。
Online shopping is more convenient for things I already know, such as my usual shampoo. For clothes, I prefer
visiting a shop because I can check the fit. Returning something that looked different on a screen can be quite a
nuisance.
熟悉的东西，比如平常用的洗发水，网购更方便。买衣服我更喜欢去店里，因为能看合不合身。东西和屏幕上看着不同，
退货会挺麻烦。
4. Do you check different prices before buying something? Why?
购物时你会比较价格吗？为什么？ 说清哪种购买值得比价，并把配送或售后也纳入真实考虑。
Yes, especially for something expensive that I expect to use for years. I compare a few shops, including delivery
costs, before deciding. For a small everyday purchase, though, saving a tiny amount isn't worth spending half an
hour searching.
会，尤其是价格高、打算用多年的东西。我会比较几家店，包括运费，再决定。不过，买日常小东西时，为省一点钱花半
小时搜索就不值得。


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
47
话题 42  /  购物
PART 1
5. Do you find it hard to decide what to buy?
购物时你很难作出选择吗？ 用商品差异过少解释犹豫，再说一个自己实际使用的选择办法。
Sometimes, when there are too many very similar options. I can spend ages comparing small details that probably
won't matter later. Having a clear budget helps, and I usually narrow it down to two choices before making the
final decision.
有时会，尤其是相似选项太多时。我可能花很久比较以后未必重要的小细节。预算明确会有帮助，我通常先缩小到两个选
项，再作最后决定。
6. Are more expensive goods always better than cheaper alternatives?
贵的商品总比便宜的好吗？ 先否定绝对判断，再区分实用质量与为外观或品牌多花的钱。
No, sometimes you're paying for the brand or the packaging. I bought a fairly cheap kitchen bowl that has lasted
for years. For me, a product is well made if it does its job reliably, regardless of its price.
不是，有时钱花在了品牌或包装上。我买过一个挺便宜的厨房碗，用了好多年。对我来说，只要东西使用起来可靠，不论
价格如何，都算做得好。
7. Have you ever sent back something you ordered online?
你有没有退过网购的东西？ 选择一个清楚的退货理由，按发现问题到办好手续的过程回答。
Yes, I returned a pair of trousers because the legs were much longer than I expected. I packed them in the original
bag and arranged a collection. The refund came through a few days later, so it was fairly straightforward.
有，我退过一条裤子，因为裤腿比预期长很多。我装回原包装袋，预约了上门取件。几天后退款到账，所以过程还算简单。
顺口表达
isn't really my thing
不太是我的兴趣
on my way home
在回家的路上
check the fit
检查是否合身
delivery costs
运费
narrow it down
缩小选择范围
well made
做工好的
the refund came through
退款到账
换成你的经历：平时很少购物，可以说集中补货而不常逛街；没有退过货就直接说明，再讲自己如何核对尺寸或减少冲动购
买。

sections.title: 街市
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
48
话题 43
PART 1
街市
Street markets
回答思路：街市可选熟悉的早市、夜市或临时摊位，先说明卖什么，再说逛起来的特点。与商场比较时关注天气、商
品和逛街目的。最近一次经历要有时间与购买内容；谈中国的街市数量可用自己的旅行见闻，避免虚构统计。
1. What do people tend to buy at street markets?
人们通常在街市买什么？ 从熟悉的街市挑两类商品，并解释其中一种为什么适合在那里买。
At the market near me, people mainly buy vegetables, fruit, and inexpensive household items. There's also a stall
selling freshly cooked breakfast food. I think the chance to buy small quantities makes these markets useful for
people living on their own.
我附近的市场主要卖蔬菜、水果和便宜的家居用品，也有卖现做早餐的摊位。我觉得可以买少量东西这一点，对独居的人
很方便。
2. Do you prefer shopping in a mall or at a street market?
你更喜欢在商场还是街市购物？ 按自己的逛街目的明确选择，再承认天气或商品会改变决定。
For a relaxed weekend outing, I'd choose a street market. I enjoy seeing different stalls and picking up something
small to eat. If I needed shoes or the weather was terrible, though, a shopping mall would be more practical.
周末轻松逛逛的话，我会选街市。我喜欢看不同摊位，顺便买点小吃。不过，如果要买鞋或天气很糟，商场就更实际。
3. When did you most recently visit a street market?
你最近一次去街市是什么时候？ 交代最近一次的时间、同行者或目的，用一个小动作还原经过。
Last Sunday morning, I went to one with my mother. We only meant to buy some tomatoes, but stopped at a stall
selling handmade baskets. We didn't buy a basket, although we spent several minutes watching the seller finish
one.
上周日早上，我和妈妈去了一次。本来只想买番茄，却停在一个卖手编篮子的摊位前。我们没买篮子，但看摊主收尾做完
一个，看了好几分钟。
4. Are street markets common in China?
中国的街市多吗？ 以自己去过的城市为证据，并说明不同街市在时间或用途上的差别。
I'd say they're quite common, although they look different from place to place. In cities I've visited, some markets
open early for food shopping, while others are busier in the evening. I wouldn't expect every neighbourhood to
have the same arrangement.
我觉得挺常见，但各地样子不同。在我去过的城市里，有些市场清早开门供人买菜，有些晚上更热闹。我不会觉得每个街
区都有同样的安排。
顺口表达
small quantities
少量
picking up something small to eat
顺便买点小吃
only meant to
本来只打算
from place to place
因地方而异
换成你的经历：附近没有街市也可以讲旅行时见到的一个；若更爱商场，就从下雨、试穿或服务方便等日常需求说明原因。

sections.title: 衣服
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
49
话题 44
PART 1
衣服
Clothing
回答思路：衣服题可以围绕面料、活动和搭配来展开，不必熟悉时尚术语。休闲与正式不是永远二选一，应说明自己
一天要做什么。工作日和周末比较可突出鞋裤或颜色。挑选时间区分每天穿衣与购买新衣，更容易给出准确答案。
1. What sorts of clothes do you enjoy wearing?
你喜欢穿什么样的衣服？ 用面料和版型各给一个具体特点，再连接到日常活动需求。
I mostly wear simple cotton tops and loose trousers. They're comfortable when I'm sitting for a long time or
walking around town. I like clothes that are easy to wash, too, because I don't want to spend ages looking after
them.
我大多穿简单的棉质上衣和宽松长裤，久坐或在城里走动都舒服。我也喜欢好洗的衣服，因为不想花很长时间打理它们。
2. Do you favour casual, comfortable clothes or smarter outfits?
你更喜欢舒适休闲的衣服还是较正式的衣服？ 先给通常选择，再解释某种正式场合为何值得暂时改变习惯。
Comfortable clothes, definitely, for an ordinary day. I find it harder to concentrate if a collar feels tight or shoes
pinch my feet. For a special dinner, though, I don't mind dressing up a little because it suits the occasion.
平常我肯定选舒服的。如果领口紧或鞋子夹脚，我就更难专注。不过，参加特别的晚餐时，我不介意稍微打扮一下，因为
这样符合场合。
3. Do you enjoy wearing T-shirts?
你喜欢穿T恤吗？ 说明穿着频率或季节，再用搭配方式解释它方便在哪里。
Yes, they're probably what I wear most often in warm weather. A plain T-shirt goes with nearly everything in my
wardrobe. When it gets cooler, I can put a shirt or a light jacket over it without changing the whole outfit.
喜欢，天气暖和时我大概最常穿的就是T恤。纯色T恤几乎能搭配我衣柜里的所有东西。凉一些时，外面加衬衫或薄外套
就行，不用换整套衣服。

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
50
话题 44  /  衣服
PART 1
4. Does choosing your clothes take you a long time?
挑选衣服会花你很长时间吗？ 明确平常穿衣所花的时间，并说明提前准备如何影响选择过程。
Not on a normal morning. Most of my clothes match each other, so I can get dressed quite quickly. If there's an
important occasion, I'll choose something the night before, which saves me from trying on several outfits while
I'm rushing.
普通早晨不会。我的衣服大多能互相搭配，所以很快就能穿好。如果有重要场合，我会前一晚选好，免得赶时间时还要试
好几套。
5. Do your weekday clothes differ from what you wear at weekends?
你工作日和周末穿的衣服风格不同吗？ 比较两个时段具体穿什么，并用活动要求说明差别为何出现。
A little. During the week, I usually wear neat trousers and a plain shirt, especially if I have meetings. At weekends,
it's more likely to be jeans and a sweatshirt. I still choose comfortable shoes whichever day it is.
有一点。工作日我通常穿整洁的长裤和简单衬衫，尤其是有会议时。周末更可能穿牛仔裤和卫衣。不管哪一天，我都会选
舒服的鞋。
6. Which colours do you like in your clothes?
你喜欢什么颜色的衣服？ 选两种常穿颜色解释搭配便利，再补一种小范围使用的亮色。
I tend to choose navy and grey because they're easy to combine with other colours. They're also quite forgiving
when I spill something. Occasionally I wear a yellow scarf to brighten things up, but I rarely buy a completely
bright outfit.
我通常选藏蓝和灰色，因为它们容易配其他颜色，弄洒东西时污迹也不太显眼。偶尔会戴黄色围巾提亮一下，但很少买整
套鲜艳的衣服。
顺口表达
loose trousers
宽松长裤
dressing up a little
稍微打扮正式一些
goes with nearly everything
几乎什么都能搭配
the night before
前一天晚上
neat trousers
整洁的长裤
brighten things up
让整体显得明亮活泼
换成你的经历：不在意穿搭也可谈容易清洗和不用熨烫；若日常必须穿制服，就解释下班或周末怎样换回喜欢的衣服。

sections.title: 鞋子
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
51
话题 45
PART 1
鞋子
Shoes
回答思路：鞋子可以从走路距离、舒适程度和实际用途回答，喜欢买不等于买得频繁。运动鞋与时尚鞋有时重合，说
明优先考虑什么即可。网购经历要具体到尺码或脚感；预算题用更换频率及愿意多付钱的原因代替生硬报价。
1. Do you enjoy shopping for shoes?
你喜欢买鞋吗？ 区分期待穿新鞋与实际试鞋过程，避免喜欢或不喜欢后无话可说。
Only when I actually need a pair. I like finding shoes that feel right, but trying on several sizes can get tiring. Once
I discover a comfortable style, I often buy something similar next time instead of starting the search again.
只有确实需要时才喜欢。我喜欢找到脚感合适的鞋，但试好几个尺码挺累。一旦发现舒服的款式，下次我常买相似的，免
得重新开始找。
2. Would you choose sports shoes or shoes mainly for their style?
你更喜欢运动鞋还是时尚鞋？ 明确优先选择并联系走路场景，也可说明外观怎样兼顾。
Sports shoes, most of the time, because I do quite a lot of walking. I still care about how they look, but comfort
comes first. A simple pair in a neutral colour usually works with most of my everyday clothes.
大多数时候选运动鞋，因为我走路比较多。我也在意外观，但舒适最重要。一双色调中性的简单运动鞋通常能搭配大多数
日常衣服。
3. Have you ordered shoes online before?
你以前在网上买过鞋吗？ 说明一次购买是否成功，并交代尺码信息怎样影响后来的购买习惯。
Yes, but only after trying the same model in a shop. I knew which size fitted, so ordering another colour was fairly
safe. With an unfamiliar brand, I'd rather try the shoes on first because sizes can feel quite different.
买过，但我是在店里试过同款之后才买的。我知道哪个尺码合脚，所以再买另一种颜色比较稳妥。遇到不熟悉的品牌，我
宁愿先试穿，因为尺码的脚感可能差很多。
4. Do you spend much money on footwear?
你会在鞋子上花很多钱吗？ 把单价和购买频率区别开，解释愿意付多少钱背后的使用需求。
Not very much overall, because I don't buy shoes often. I am willing to pay a bit more for a pair I'll wear every
day, though. I'd rather own two comfortable pairs than several cheap ones that hurt my feet.
总的来说不多，因为我不常买鞋。不过，每天都穿的鞋，我愿意多花一点。比起几双穿着脚疼的便宜鞋，我更愿意只有两
双舒服的。
顺口表达
trying on several sizes
试穿几个尺码
comfort comes first
舒适最重要
try the shoes on
试穿这些鞋
pay a bit more
多付一点钱
换成你的经历：没有网购过鞋也可解释需要试穿；不热衷买鞋就说旧鞋穿坏才换，用每天走路的真实需要支持选择。

sections.title: 手表
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
52
话题 46
PART 1
手表
Watches
回答思路：手表题先说自己是否戴，再交代看时间、运动或纪念等主要用途。收到礼物时重点是赠送者与场合。昂贵
手表可能关乎外观、工艺或个人意义，不把所有购买者都说成炫耀。重要性则结合自己能否用手机替代来判断。
1. Do you usually have a watch on?
你通常戴手表吗？ 说明频率和用途，用不方便拿手机的场景解释戴表的原因。
Yes, I wear a basic watch most days. It's useful when I'm in a meeting and don't want to take out my phone just to
check the time. I also like being able to glance at it while waiting for a bus.
戴，大多数日子我都会戴一块普通手表。开会时不想只为看时间就拿手机，它很方便。等公交时能瞥一眼手表，我也觉得
省事。
2. Has anyone ever given you a watch as a present?
你有没有收到过手表礼物？ 讲清送礼场合与具体外观，再解释为什么现在仍愿意保留。
My aunt gave me one when I finished secondary school. It had a brown strap and a very plain face, which suited
me. I still wear it occasionally, partly because it's practical and partly because it reminds me of her.
我中学毕业时，姑姑送过我一块。它是棕色表带，表盘很简洁，很适合我。我现在偶尔还戴，一方面实用，另一方面能让
我想起她。
3. What attracts some people to expensive watches?
有些人为什么喜欢昂贵的手表？ 提出两种可能动机而不猜测所有人的心理，承认喜好因人而异。
Some people appreciate the design and the work that goes into making them. Others might buy one to mark a
special occasion, like a promotion. Of course, a watch can also show status, but I wouldn't assume that's
everyone's main reason.
有些人欣赏设计和制作工艺。另一些人可能用它纪念升职等特殊时刻。当然，手表也能显示身份，但我不会认为这是所有
人的主要原因。
4. How important do you think wearing a watch is, and why?
你觉得戴手表重要吗？为什么？ 区分有用与不可缺少，结合自己一天中的实际限制说明判断。
I find it useful, but I wouldn't call it essential. Most of the time, I can check a clock or my phone instead. A watch
becomes more helpful when using a phone would be distracting or look rude during a conversation.
我觉得有用，但谈不上必需。大多数时候，我也能看钟或手机。交谈时，如果用手机会让人分心或显得无礼，手表就更有
帮助。
顺口表达
check the time
看时间
a very plain face
很简洁的表盘
mark a special occasion
纪念一个特殊时刻
wouldn't call it essential
不会说它必不可少
换成你的经历：不戴表也可以讲取手机看时间的习惯；没收到过手表，就直接说明，并说自己是否会喜欢这种礼物。

4. How important do you think wearing a watch is, and why?

sections.title: 眼镜
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
53
话题 47
PART 1
眼镜
Glasses
回答思路：眼镜题可以谈佩戴场景、镜框和舒适度，无须给专业眼科建议。身边人的情况用亲友或同学举例。时尚感
可联系脸型与衣服，预算则区分镜片需求和镜框品牌；说明每天使用带来的价值，比简单说贵或便宜更充分。
1. Do you generally wear glasses?
你通常戴眼镜吗？ 说明平时什么时候戴，再用一个生活细节呈现自己的使用习惯。
Yes, I wear them most of the day. I can manage without them briefly, but things in the distance look blurry. I keep
a spare pair at home because losing or breaking my main pair would be very inconvenient.
戴，我一天大部分时间都戴。短时间不戴也能应付，但远处的东西看起来模糊。我家里留了一副备用的，因为常戴的眼镜
丢了或坏了会很不方便。
2. Do many of the people you know wear glasses?
你身边有很多人戴眼镜吗？ 把回答范围限定为认识的人，用佩戴频率的差别补充观察。
Quite a few of my friends do, and so does my father. Some wear glasses all day, while others only put them on for
reading. It's such a familiar sight in my circle that I barely notice it anymore.
挺多朋友都戴，我爸爸也戴。有些人全天戴，有些人只在看书时戴。在我认识的人中，这已经很常见，我几乎都不会特意
注意了。
3. Can glasses be fashionable, in your view?
你觉得眼镜可以很时尚吗？ 从镜框怎样改变整体外观解释判断，同时保留个人选择差异。
Definitely. The shape and colour of the frames can change someone's whole appearance. A friend switched to a
round pair recently, and they really suit her. Personally, I'd still choose something comfortable over a fashionable
pair that keeps sliding down.
当然可以。镜框的形状和颜色能改变一个人的整体形象。一位朋友最近换了圆框眼镜，很适合她。不过我自己还是更愿意
选舒服的，不选时髦却总往下滑的。
4. Would you pay a lot for a pair of glasses?
你愿意花很多钱买一副眼镜吗？ 说明愿意付钱的实际条件，把镜片舒适与品牌溢价分开考虑。
I'd spend enough to get lenses that meet my needs and frames that feel comfortable. Since I'd wear them every
day, quality matters. But I wouldn't pay a huge amount just for a designer name printed on the side.
我愿意花足够的钱买符合需要的镜片和戴着舒服的镜框。因为每天都要戴，质量很重要。但我不会仅为镜腿上的设计师品
牌名字付特别高的价格。
顺口表达
a spare pair
一副备用眼镜
a familiar sight
常见的景象
keeps sliding down
总往下滑
meet my needs
满足我的需要
换成你的经历：不戴近视眼镜也可明确说只戴太阳镜；预算有限就说明优先考虑合适与耐用，不必为了完整而编具体价格。

sections.title: 耳机
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
54
话题 48
PART 1
耳机
Headphones
回答思路：耳机可以按通勤、学习、通话等场景来讲，频率不用报很精确的数字。有用的理由既包括听清内容，也包
括不打扰别人。谈普及程度用身边所见，最后区分需要听见交通或别人讲话的场合，解释什么时候应先摘下耳机。
1. How frequently do you use headphones?
你多久戴一次耳机？ 给出大致频率与固定用途，补充什么时候会主动摘下更自然。
Almost every weekday, mainly on the bus to listen to podcasts. I also use them for online meetings when other
people are nearby. Once I'm home and doing nothing in particular, I usually take them off and enjoy the quiet.
几乎每个工作日都会，主要在公交车上听播客。旁边有人时，开线上会议我也会用。回家没什么特别的事时，我通常就摘
下来，享受安静。
2. How useful do you think headphones are?
你觉得耳机有用吗？ 从自己与周围人的两个角度解释用途，用共享空间作具体情境。
Very useful, especially in shared spaces. I can watch a lesson or take a call without forcing everyone else to hear
it. They also help me hear quiet speech more clearly, although I try not to turn the volume up too high.
很有用，尤其在共用空间里。我可以看课程或接电话，不必让所有人都听着。它们也能让我听清较轻的说话声，不过我尽
量不把音量调得太高。
3. Are headphones widely used in your country?
耳机在你们国家普及吗？ 用通勤和工作学习中的观察支持判断，不需要猜测普及比例。
They seem very common, particularly among people commuting or studying in cafés. On my usual bus, I often
notice passengers wearing small wireless earphones. Larger headphones are around too, but they stand out more
because they're much easier to see.
看起来很常见，尤其是通勤的人和在咖啡馆学习的人。我常坐的公交车上，经常能看见乘客戴小型无线耳机。大耳机也有，
只是更显眼，因为更容易被看见。
4. When is it better not to wear headphones?
哪些情况下最好不要戴耳机？ 挑两个需要听环境或人声的场合，解释摘下耳机的具体目的。
I'd take them off when crossing a busy road, because I want to hear what's happening around me. They're also best
removed when someone is speaking to you directly. Even with no sound playing, wearing them can make you
seem unavailable.
过繁忙道路时我会摘下来，因为我想听清周围的情况。有人直接和你讲话时也最好摘下。即使没在播放声音，戴着也可能
让人觉得你不方便交流。
顺口表达
take them off
把它们摘下来
turn the volume up
调高音量
wireless earphones
无线耳机
speaking to you directly
直接和你说话
换成你的经历：不常用耳机可以解释戴久不舒服或环境本来安静；判断不适合的场景时，选择自己确实需要留意声音的时刻。

sections.title: 电脑与平板
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
55
话题 49
PART 1
电脑与平板
Computers and tablets
回答思路：电脑和平板的选择可从输入长文、阅读和携带三个具体需要中选两点。使用情境题要说正在完成的任务，
首次使用则交代年龄与初次操作。没有设备的设想要指出哪些事变慢或改用纸笔，不必夸大成生活完全无法进行。
1. Would you rather use a computer or a tablet?
你更愿意用电脑还是平板？ 按最常做的任务给出选择，具体解释键盘或屏幕怎样影响使用。
A computer, if I had to choose just one. I write quite a lot, and a proper keyboard makes that much easier. Tablets
are handy for reading on the sofa, but I wouldn't want to type a long report on one.
如果只能选一个，我选电脑。我写东西比较多，实体键盘方便得多。平板适合坐沙发上阅读，但我不想在上面打长报告。
2. For what kinds of tasks would you use a computer or tablet?
你会在什么情况下使用电脑或平板？ 分别给两种设备安排具体任务，体现情境而不是重复一般优点。
I use my laptop when I need several documents open at once, especially for writing or comparing information. A
tablet would be more convenient for following a recipe in the kitchen, where I mainly need to read rather than
type.
写作或比较资料时，如果需要同时打开几份文件，我会用笔记本电脑。厨房里照食谱做菜则用平板更方便，因为主要是看，
不需要打字。
3. When did you first use a computer or tablet?
你第一次用电脑或平板是什么时候？ 用年龄阶段和第一次完成的小任务展开，不必编造设备型号。
I first used a computer in primary school, during a lesson in the computer room. We were asked to draw a simple
house using the mouse. Getting a straight roof line was surprisingly difficult, but I remember being very pleased
with it.
我第一次用电脑是在小学的一节机房课上。老师让我们用鼠标画一栋简单的房子。把屋顶画直比想象中难，但我记得当时
对作品很满意。
4. How would life change for you without computers or tablets?
没有电脑或平板，你的生活会怎样？ 明确哪些任务受影响最明显，也说明能够用什么方式继续完成。
Writing and organising information would take me much longer. I could still use paper notebooks, but searching
through old notes wouldn't be as quick. I'd probably spend less time staring at a screen, though, which might be a
welcome change.
写东西和整理信息会花我更久。我仍能用纸质笔记本，但翻找旧笔记不会那么快。不过，我可能会少盯屏幕一段时间，这
或许是个令人欣喜的变化。
顺口表达
a proper keyboard
实体键盘
at once
同时
using the mouse
使用鼠标
a welcome change
令人欣喜的变化
换成你的经历：没用过平板也可以只谈电脑，再说明对平板的合理期待；首次接触记不清年龄时，用小学或中学阶段代替。

sections.title: 打字
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
56
话题 50
PART 1
打字
Typing
回答思路：打字题区分输入长文和手写短记的需要，不必选出永远更好的方式。每天是否用键盘要和手机打字分开。
学习经历可以讲最早找按键的困难；提高方法要说明练什么、怎样发现错误，而不是空泛地说多练就会熟练。
1. Do you prefer to type or write by hand?
你更喜欢打字还是手写？ 按长文修改与短记思考区分用途，避免把方便只说成速度快。
For anything long, I prefer typing because I can move sentences around without making a mess. For a quick
reminder, handwriting is easier. I also like using a pen when I'm thinking through an idea and want to draw arrows
between things.
写长内容我更喜欢打字，因为调整句子顺序不会弄得乱七八糟。简单提醒手写更方便。琢磨一个想法、想在内容之间画箭
头时，我也喜欢用笔。
2. Do you use a desktop or laptop keyboard every day?
你每天都用台式电脑或笔记本电脑键盘打字吗？ 给出工作日的大致频率，并与不碰电脑的休息日作简单区分。
Almost every day during the week. I use a laptop keyboard to write messages, take notes, and edit documents. At
weekends, I sometimes leave the computer closed all day, especially if I'm going out and only need my phone.
工作日几乎每天都用。我用笔记本键盘发消息、记笔记、编辑文件。周末有时整天不打开电脑，尤其是出门、只需要手机
的时候。
3. When did you first learn to type?
你什么时候学会用键盘打字的？ 区分初次练习与熟练阶段，用找字母的变化说明学习经过。
I started in primary school, but I was very slow at first. I had to look for each letter before pressing it. Later, typing
messages to friends gave me regular practice, and I gradually stopped watching my hands so closely.
我从小学开始学，但最初很慢，每按一个字母都得先找。后来给朋友打字发消息让我经常练习，慢慢就不用一直盯着手了。
4. What do you do to become better at typing?
你怎样提高打字水平？ 选择一个实际练习动作，解释先减少错误为何比一味求快有用。
I try to focus on accuracy before speed. If I keep making the same mistake, I slow down and practise that letter
combination a few times. Short, regular sessions seem more useful to me than one long session when I'm tired.
我尽量先重视准确，再追求速度。如果总犯同一个错，我会慢下来，把那组字母练几遍。对我来说，短时间经常练，比疲
倦时一口气练很久更有用。
顺口表达
move sentences around
调整句子位置
edit documents
编辑文件
regular practice
经常练习
focus on accuracy
重视准确性
换成你的经历：主要用手机的人可以直接说明很少碰电脑键盘；如果没系统学过，就说通过日常聊天或完成作业慢慢熟悉按
键。

sections.title: 纸质书信
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
57
话题 51
PART 1
纸质书信
Paper letters
回答思路：书信题要分清写过、收过与现在更常用的沟通方式。纸信的价值可以来自字迹和保存，电子消息则强调速
度及安排事情的方便。两道偏好题分别比较即时聊天与电子邮件。未来预测保留可能性，不把个人习惯说成所有人的
趋势。
1. Do you ever write letters on paper?
你会写纸质信件吗？ 明确频率与收信对象，用慢慢书写的场景解释少写却仍会写。
Very occasionally. I wrote one to a friend who moved away because I wanted to include a few printed
photographs. Sitting down with paper made me think more carefully about what I wanted to tell her than a quick
message would.
很偶尔。我曾写信给搬走的朋友，因为想附上几张打印的照片。坐下来用纸写，让我比发一条简短消息时更认真地想自己
想告诉她什么。
2. Did anyone send you handwritten letters when you were young?
小时候有人给你寄过手写信吗？ 选一位写信者，交代信的内容和等待收到时的具体感受。
Yes, my cousin sent me a few during the summer holidays. She described little things like swimming lessons and a
new puppy next door. I remember checking the letterbox eagerly because receiving something with my name on it
felt quite grown-up.
有，表姐暑假给我寄过几封。她写游泳课和邻居新养的小狗等小事。我记得自己很期待地查看信箱，因为收到写着自己名
字的东西，感觉像个大人了。
3. Would you choose handwritten letters, instant messages, or text messages?
你更喜欢手写信、即时消息还是短信？ 先按日常沟通作选择，再为需要认真表达的场合保留书信位置。
For everyday contact, instant messages are the easiest choice. I can ask a quick question and get a reply while
making other plans. A handwritten letter feels more personal, though, so I'd prefer one for something I wanted to
keep and reread.
日常联系我觉得即时消息最方便。我可以问个小问题，在安排其他事情时收到回复。不过手写信更有亲近感，所以想保留
并反复读的内容，我更愿意收到信。


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
58
话题 51  /  纸质书信
PART 1
4. Do you prefer writing a letter or sending an email?
你更喜欢写信还是发电子邮件？ 与即时聊天题分开，用正式安排或附件说明选择邮件的具体原因。
Usually an email, especially if I'm arranging something or sharing a document. It's easier to correct a mistake and
attach the information the other person needs. I might choose a paper letter for a personal thank-you that deserves
a little more time.
通常是邮件，尤其是安排事情或分享文件时。它便于改错，也方便附上对方需要的资料。如果是值得多花点时间表达的私
人感谢，我可能会选纸信。
5. Do you think paper letters could disappear entirely in the future?
你觉得纸质信件未来会完全消失吗？ 区别日常使用减少与彻底消失，用值得保存的用途支持预测。
I doubt they'll disappear completely, even if fewer people use them for ordinary communication. Some people
enjoy the physical object and the handwriting itself. A letter from someone important can be kept for years, which
gives it a different appeal from a message.
我觉得它们不会完全消失，即使日常沟通中用信的人减少。有些人喜欢实体的信和字迹本身。重要的人写的信能保存多年，
这让它有着不同于消息的吸引力。
顺口表达
printed photographs
打印的照片
checking the letterbox
查看信箱
keep and reread
保留并反复阅读
attach the information
附上资料
ordinary communication
日常沟通
换成你的经历：从没写过信也完全可以说明平时怎样联系亲友；童年未收过信就坦白回答，再说收到手写卡片的相近经历。

sections.title: 网站
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
59
话题 52
PART 1
网站
Websites
回答思路：网站题用具体任务串起内容：查做法、找资料或看视频。最喜欢的网站可以讲最常用的功能，无须详细介
绍公司。变化题挑一个界面或使用方式的改变，说明好坏。谈全国流行类型时，用身边常见的使用需求支持自己的印
象。
1. What types of websites do you regularly use?
你经常访问什么类型的网站？ 选两类网站并分别对应实际需求，避免只罗列几个熟悉的名字。
I often use recipe websites and sites that explain practical skills. If something at home stops working, I'll look for a
clear guide before asking for help. I also visit news sites, although I don't spend much time reading every story.
我经常用食谱网站和讲解实用技能的网站。家里东西坏了，我会先找一份清楚的指南，再求助。我也看新闻网站，不过不
会花很多时间把每条都读完。
2. Which website do you like best?
你最喜欢哪个网站？ 描述一个常用网站的核心功能，再解释它怎样解决你的具体困难。
My favourite is a cooking website with recipes for small households. I like that it tells you what to do with leftover
ingredients. When I buy a whole cabbage, for instance, it helps me plan more than one meal around it.
我最喜欢一个提供少人数家庭食谱的烹饪网站。它会告诉你剩余食材怎么用，我很喜欢这点。比如买了一整棵卷心菜，它
能帮我计划用它做不止一顿饭。
3. Have the websites you visit changed in any way?
你常访问的网站有什么变化吗？ 选一项自己注意到的改变，说明它怎样影响查找或阅读过程。
Yes, one site I use for recipes has added more videos. They're helpful for seeing how something should look, but
the pages take longer to load. I sometimes miss being able to open a simple page and read the instructions
immediately.
有，我用的一个食谱网站加了更多视频。视频能帮助我看清食物应该是什么样，但页面加载更慢了。有时我怀念打开简单
页面就能立即读步骤的方式。
4. What kinds of websites are widely used in your country?
你们国家什么类型的网站比较受欢迎？ 结合身边人的使用说出两类，说明它们分别满足什么日常需要。
Shopping and video websites seem especially popular among people I know. They use them to compare products,
watch tutorials, or relax after work. Education sites are useful too, particularly when someone is preparing for an
exam or learning a new skill.
在我认识的人里，购物和视频网站似乎特别受欢迎。大家用来比较产品、看教程或下班后放松。教育网站也有用，尤其是
准备考试或学新技能时。
顺口表达
a clear guide
一份清楚的指南
leftover ingredients
剩余食材
take longer to load
加载需要更久
compare products
比较产品
换成你的经历：记不起网站名称可以描述内容和主要功能；如果多用应用程序，可先说明，再讲偶尔通过浏览器完成的任务。

sections.title: 社交媒体
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
60
话题 53
PART 1
社交媒体
Social media
回答思路：社交媒体题可以按最初加入、现在使用和朋友习惯来组织。谈用时过多时，说明原本想做什么又被什么拖
住，比只报时长更具体。谈常见用途同时考虑发布与浏览两类行为。第一题按开始使用的时间作答，交代当时的联系
需求。
1. When did you first start using social media?
你是什么时候开始使用社交媒体的？ 交代年龄阶段与最初用途，让开始时间和当时的生活自然相连。
I started in my early teens, mainly because my classmates had a group for sharing homework reminders. At first, I
barely posted anything myself. I mostly checked messages and looked at friends' photos, so using it felt quite
ordinary very quickly.
我十几岁时开始用，主要因为同学建了分享作业提醒的群。一开始我几乎不发东西，主要看消息和朋友的照片，所以很快
就觉得使用它是日常小事。
2. Do you feel you spend too long on social media?
你觉得自己在社交媒体上花的时间太多吗？ 给出一次常发生的时间失控过程，再说明自己采取的小调整。
Sometimes, yes. I open an app to reply to one message and end up scrolling through videos for much longer than I
intended. I've started leaving my phone on a shelf during dinner, which helps me break that habit for a while.
有时是的。我打开应用本想回一条消息，结果刷视频的时间比原打算长得多。我开始吃饭时把手机放到架子上，这能让我
暂时摆脱那个习惯。
3. Do the people you are friends with use social media?
你的朋友们使用社交媒体吗？ 说明大多数朋友是否使用，再用发帖频率的区别呈现真实差异。
Most of them do, but in different ways. A few post photos almost every day, while others only use group chats to
organise things. One friend rarely shares anything publicly, although she's usually the first person to reply to a
private message.
大多数用，但方式不同。有几位几乎每天发照片，有些只用群聊组织事情。一位朋友很少公开分享，但私信发过去，她通
常是第一个回复的人。
4. What do people commonly do on social media?
人们通常在社交媒体上做什么？ 把主动发布与被动浏览各说一种用途，避免只把所有使用等同聊天。
They keep in touch, share little updates, and look for things that interest them. Someone might post holiday
pictures, while another person quietly follows cooking accounts. People also use local groups to ask practical
questions, such as where to repair a bicycle.
大家联系彼此、分享小近况，也找感兴趣的内容。有人发度假照片，有人只是默默关注做饭账号。人们也会在本地群里问
实际问题，比如哪里能修自行车。
顺口表达
homework reminders
作业提醒
end up scrolling
结果一直刷下去
group chats
群聊
keep in touch
保持联系
换成你的经历：很少发动态的人也在使用社交媒体，可以讲看消息或群聊；若完全不用，就解释目前怎样与朋友保持联系。

4. What do people commonly do on social media?

sections.title: 广告
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
购物用品与网络生活
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
61
话题 54
PART 1
广告
Advertising
回答思路：广告题不需要记住品牌名，可以描述画面、音乐或一句表达。童年印象要说明为什么记住，交通和电子设备题
则说出现的位置与是否打断自己。是否喜欢和喜欢哪类分开回答，后者给出明确标准，例如信息清楚、篇幅简短或幽默自
然。
1. Do you remember an advertisement that stood out to you as a child?
你记得小时候哪则广告给你留下了印象吗？ 不必记品牌，用一个画面或声音说明广告为什么一直留在记忆里。
I remember a television advert with a dog carrying slippers to its owner. I can't recall what it was selling, but the dog
looked very pleased with itself. My brother and I used to copy the little tune afterwards.
我记得一则电视广告，里面一只狗给主人叼拖鞋。我想不起它卖什么，但那只狗看起来很得意。后来我和哥哥常模仿里面的
小曲调。
2. Do you notice much advertising on trains or other public transport?
你在火车或其他公共交通工具上看到很多广告吗？ 列一个自己常见的交通场景，说明广告在哪以及何时会注意。
Yes, especially on the underground. There are posters beside the escalators and above the seats, so they're difficult to
miss. I don't read all of them, but a large picture sometimes catches my eye when I'm waiting for the doors to open.
看得到，尤其是地铁里。扶梯旁和座位上方都有海报，很难完全看不见。我不会每张都读，但等车门打开时，大图片有时会
吸引我的注意。
3. Do advertisements often appear while you use your phone or computer?
用手机或电脑时，你经常看到广告吗？ 选一种出现方式说明频率，再说明它对当前任务有什么影响。
All the time, particularly before videos and between posts on social media. I can ignore a small advertisement fairly
easily, but one that covers the page is frustrating. I have to stop what I'm doing just to find the close button.
经常，尤其是视频开始前和社交媒体帖子之间。小广告我很容易忽略，但遮住页面的广告很烦人。我得停下正在做的事，专
门找关闭按钮。
4. How do you feel about advertisements?
你喜欢广告吗？ 给出整体态度，再明确哪些呈现方式让你接受或感到烦扰。
I don't mind them when they're brief and relevant to something I need. An advert for a nearby exhibition might be
useful, for example. What bothers me is seeing the same one repeatedly, especially when I can't skip it and continue
watching.
简短、又和我需要的东西有关的广告，我不介意。比如附近展览的广告可能有用。让我烦的是反复看同一则，尤其是不能跳
过、继续看内容的时候。
5. Which types of advertising appeal to you?
你喜欢哪种类型的广告？ 选一种表达风格并说明为何有效，最好给出信息与画面的具体关系。
I like simple adverts that show a product being used in a believable situation. A little humour helps, as long as it
doesn't hide what the advert is actually about. Clear pictures and a short explanation are usually enough to interest me.
我喜欢简单的广告，展示产品在可信场景中如何使用。带一点幽默也好，只要不让人看不懂广告到底在讲什么。清楚的图片
和简短说明通常就足以引起我的兴趣。
顺口表达
pleased with itself
对自己很得意
catches my eye
吸引我的注意
the close button
关闭按钮
don't mind them
不介意它们
a believable situation
可信的情境
换成你的经历：想不起童年广告可以直说记不清品牌但记得画面；不喜欢广告也能挑出较能接受的一类，不必硬说自己爱看。

sections.title: 童年好友
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
62
话题 55
PART 2
童年好友
A childhood friend
Describe a childhood friend you can still remember clearly.
描述一位你至今仍记得很清楚的童年朋友。
1. Who this friend is
这位朋友是谁
2. How you first became friends
你们最初怎样相识
3. The things you did together as children
小时候一起做过什么
4. Why this friend remains so clear in your memory
为什么至今仍清楚地记得这位朋友
审题与选材：人物题不能只列善良、开朗等形容词。先用同桌和放学路线说明两人的关系，再选一次丢失作业的具体小事，
让朋友的做法解释你为何记得他。日常活动用过去常做的表达，关键事件用一般过去时，最后自然交代如今是否联系。
叙述顺序
A 交代小学同桌的姓名与关系 - B 说明借用铅笔让两人成为朋友 - C 回忆放学后常做的两件小事 - D 展开一起寻找作业本
的经过 - E 说明这份体贴为何留在记忆
A Introduce my friend from primary school - B Explain how borrowing pencils started our friendship - C Describe our
usual activities after school - D Recall searching together for my missing notebook - E Connect his kindness with my
lasting memory
示例回答
My clearest childhood memories usually include a boy called Wei, who sat next to me in primary school. We
first met when I was eight. On my first morning, I'd forgotten my pencil case, and he quietly pushed two pencils
across the desk. That was basically how our friendship started. We lived a few streets apart, so we normally
walked home together. We used to stop at a little playground and invent games with stones and fallen leaves. On
rainy days, we'd sit on the stairs outside his flat and trade comic books instead. One afternoon, I realised I'd lost
the notebook containing a week's homework. I was nearly in tears because I thought our teacher would be
furious. Wei walked all the way back to school with me, checking every place we'd stopped. We eventually
found it under a playground bench, slightly muddy but still readable. He didn't complain once, even though it
made him late for dinner. His family moved away the following year, and we gradually lost touch. I remember
him so well because he made an anxious child feel that someone was on his side. Even now, that image of two
pencils sliding towards me is surprisingly clear.
中文对照：我最清楚的童年记忆里，总有小学同桌小伟。我们第一次见面的时候，我才八岁。第一天上学，我忘带笔袋，
他默默地把两支铅笔推到我面前，我们的友谊基本上就是从这个小小的动作开始的。我们住得只隔几条街，经常一起走回
家。路上会去小游乐场，用石头和落叶编游戏。下雨时，就坐在他家门外的楼梯上交换漫画书。有天下午，我发现写了一
周作业的本子丢了，怕老师生气，急得快哭了。小伟陪我一路走回学校，把停留过的地方都找了一遍，最后在游乐场长椅
下面找到了本子。它有点脏，但字还能看清。虽然回家吃饭迟了，他也没抱怨。第二年他搬走了，我们渐渐失去联系。我
一直记得他，因为他让当时容易紧张的我觉得有人支持自己。直到现在，两支铅笔滑到我面前的画面仍然很清楚。
自然表达
sit next to someone
坐在某人旁边
trade comic books
交换漫画书
lose touch
失去联系
be on someone's side
支持某人；站在某人一边
串题 话题 56 跟朋友度过的美好夜晚
可沿用童年朋友的人物和相处习惯，但美好夜晚要另有一次真实相聚，补齐时间地点与当晚活动，不能只讲多年友谊。
The same friend comes to mind when I think about an evening we particularly enjoyed together.

朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
63
话题 55  /  童年好友
PART 3
1. Are you still in contact with your childhood
friends, and why?
你还和童年朋友保持联系吗？为什么？ 把仍有联系和失联的
人分开说，用共同经历解释留下的联系。
I'm still in touch with two of them, mainly through a
small messaging group. We don't speak every day, but
shared memories make conversation easy whenever we
reconnect. Others have drifted away because we moved
to different cities. I don't think that means those earlier
friendships were any less valuable.
我还和其中两人通过一个小聊天群保持联系。我们不是每天
说话，但共同的回忆让每次重新聊天都很自然。还有些人因
为搬到不同城市渐渐失联了，我觉得这并不说明过去的友谊
不珍贵。
drift away 逐渐疏远
2. How much do childhood friendships matter to
children?
童年友谊对孩子有多重要？ 解释朋友怎样带来安全感，再用
一起玩时的分歧说明学习过程。
They matter a great deal because friends give children
somewhere to belong outside their family. Playing
together also involves taking turns, disagreeing and
making up afterwards. For example, choosing rules for a
playground game teaches negotiation in a very practical
way. One dependable friend can make a new school feel
much less intimidating.
童年朋友很重要，因为孩子在家庭之外也需要归属感。一起
玩还意味着轮流、争执和和好。例如，为游乐场游戏商量规
则，就能很实际地练习协商。有一个可靠的朋友，新学校也
会显得没那么可怕。
take turns 轮流
3. How do you feel about using social media to
communicate?
你怎么看通过社交媒体交流？ 同时说明远距离联系的便利和
语气不清的局限，给出不同用法。
I find it useful for keeping in touch, especially when
friends live far away. Sending a photo takes seconds and
gives people something specific to talk about. The
difficulty is that short messages can sound colder than
intended. For a sensitive conversation, I'd usually move
from the chat window to a call.
我觉得它很适合维持日常联系，尤其是朋友住得远时。发张
照片只需几秒，也能提供具体话题。问题是短消息听起来可
能比原意冷淡。如果遇到需要谨慎处理的敏感话题，我通常
会从文字聊天转成打电话。
keep in touch 保持联系
4. Will social media communication eventually take
the place of meeting in person?
社交媒体交流最终会取代面对面见面吗？ 区分简单信息和需
要共同体验的交流，解释不能完全取代的原因。
It will replace some routine conversations, but I doubt it
will replace meeting altogether. Online messages are
enough for arranging a time or sharing an address.
Spending an afternoon together provides facial
expressions, comfortable silences and shared
experiences that a chat cannot fully offer. People may
communicate online more while still valuing occasional
visits.
它会取代一些日常对话，但我不认为见面会完全消失。约时
间、发地址，用网上消息就够了。一起度过一个下午则有表
情、自在的沉默和共同经历，这些文字聊天难以完全提供。
人们可能上网聊得更多，却仍珍惜偶尔见面。
routine conversations 日常例行交流
5. How does having younger friends compare with
having older ones?
交比自己年轻的朋友和年长的朋友有什么不同？ 比较常见的
经历差异而非给年龄贴标签，最后保留个人差别。
Younger friends may introduce you to unfamiliar
interests, while older friends sometimes have experience
of decisions you're facing. An older colleague might
explain what moving out involves; a younger friend
could suggest a new hobby. Still, age isn't a reliable
guide to personality. I value curiosity and mutual respect
more than someone's birth year.
年轻朋友可能带来陌生的兴趣，年长朋友有时经历过你正面
对的决定。例如，年长同事能解释独立居住要考虑什么，年
轻朋友会推荐新爱好。不过年龄不能可靠地说明性格，我更
看重好奇心和彼此尊重。
mutual respect 相互尊重
6. In what ways has technology affected friendships?
科技从哪些方面改变了友谊？ 分别说联系距离与相处方式的
变化，用群聊和见面分心形成对照。
Technology has made friendships less dependent on
living nearby. Friends can play games together or share
ordinary moments from different countries. It has also
changed expectations: people sometimes assume an
unanswered message means rejection. So staying
connected is easier, but managing attention and giving
each other time away from screens have become more
important.
科技让友谊不再那么依赖住得近。朋友即使身在不同国家，
也能一起打游戏或分享日常。它还改变了期待：有人会把消
息未回复理解成拒绝。因此联系更方便了，但专心相处、允
许彼此暂时离开屏幕也更重要。
stay connected 保持联系

sections.title: 跟朋友度过的美好夜晚
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
64
话题 56
PART 2
跟朋友度过的美好夜晚
A good evening with friends
Describe an evening that you enjoyed spending with friends.
描述一个与朋友共度的愉快夜晚。
1. When and where the evening took place
时间与地点
2. Which friends were there
和哪些朋友一起
3. What you did together
一起做了什么
4. What made the evening enjoyable
为什么这个夜晚令人愉快
审题与选材：这道题的重点是与朋友相处的过程，而不是场所多高级。可以先交代一次临时改动，再写做饭和游戏中发生的
小插曲，把放松的感受放进动作里。结尾说明这几个人为什么能让你自在，避免只重复开心、难忘等空泛评价。
叙述顺序
A 交代周六晚在朋友家中相聚 - B 说明下雨后临时改变的安排 - C 展开大家一起包饺子的细节 - D 描述猜画游戏带来的笑
声 - E 用自在相处解释夜晚的愉快
A Set the scene at my friend's flat - B Explain why rain changed our original plan - C Describe making dumplings together
in the kitchen - D Recall the laughter during our drawing game - E Explain why the company felt so relaxing
示例回答
One evening that comes to mind was a rainy Saturday last autumn. I went to my friend Lin's flat with two former
classmates, Mei and Chen. We'd planned to eat outside, but the rain was so heavy that we decided to stay in and
make dumplings instead. None of us was particularly good at shaping them. Lin showed us how to fold the
edges, but mine kept opening up, and Chen made one that looked more like a tiny pillow. We put the strangely
shaped ones on a separate plate and jokingly called it the special collection. There was flour everywhere,
including on my sleeve. While the dumplings were cooking, we played a drawing game using scrap paper. Mei
had to draw a giraffe, but we all thought it was a broken lamp. She laughed so hard that she couldn't explain
what it was supposed to be. We ate at the small kitchen table and talked until about ten. Nothing expensive or
dramatic happened, which was actually part of the appeal. Everyone helped with the washing up, and nobody
was checking the time constantly. After a busy week, it felt lovely to be with people I didn't feel I had to
impress.
中文对照：我想起的是去年秋天一个下雨的周六晚上。我和以前的同学小梅、小陈去了朋友小林家。本来打算外出吃饭，
但雨太大，就决定留在家包饺子。我们几个人其实都不怎么擅长把饺子包成好看的样子。小林教大家捏边，我的饺子却总
开口，小陈还包出一个像小枕头的。我们把形状奇怪的放在单独的盘子里，开玩笑叫它特别系列。面粉到处都是，连我袖
子上也有。煮饺子时，我们用废纸玩猜画游戏。小梅画长颈鹿，我们却都觉得那是坏台灯，她笑得连原本想画的究竟是什
么都解释不出来。我们围着小餐桌吃饭，一直聊到十点左右。这一晚没有昂贵或戏剧性的事情，恰好也是它吸引人的地方。
大家一起洗碗，也没人总看时间。忙了一周后，能和这些不用刻意表现自己的朋友待在一起，感觉特别舒服。
自然表达
stay in
待在家里
fold the edges
把边缘折起或捏合
come to mind
浮现在脑海中
help with the washing up
帮忙洗碗
串题 话题 59 微笑的场合
可沿用朋友包饺子和猜画的场景，改为微笑场合时把重点放在奇怪饺子和长颈鹿画引发的笑容，说明为什么几个人都开心。
The moment when everyone was smiling came when we tried to guess what Mei had drawn on the paper.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
65
话题 56  /  跟朋友度过的美好夜晚
PART 3
1. What do people commonly do when they spend
time with friends?
人们和朋友相处时通常会做什么？ 按便于聊天和需要共同参
与来举活动，解释选择受时间影响。
Meals and walks are common because they leave plenty
of room for conversation. Some friends prefer activities
with a shared focus, such as badminton or board games.
The choice often depends on everyone's schedule. After
work, a quick dinner is easier to arrange than a whole
weekend trip, even among very close friends.
吃饭、散步很常见，因为有充足的聊天空间。有些朋友喜欢
有共同参与内容的活动，比如羽毛球或桌游。选择往往取决
于大家的时间。即使关系很好，下班后约顿便饭也比安排整
个周末旅行更容易。
a shared focus 共同关注或参与的事情
2. What do people tend to do together with their
parents?
人们通常会和父母一起做什么？ 从做饭购物等家庭日常切入，
再说明活动需要照顾彼此的体力和喜好。
A lot of time with parents revolves around ordinary
routines, like cooking, shopping or having dinner. Some
families also watch a programme together or take a short
outing at weekends. Activities need to suit everyone's
energy and interests. A relaxed walk can allow better
conversation than an ambitious trip with a packed
schedule.
和父母相处的很多时间围绕做饭、购物、吃饭等日常活动。
有些家庭也一起看节目，或周末短途出游。活动需要适合大
家的体力和兴趣。轻松散步有时比安排满满的远行更方便好
好聊天。
a packed schedule 排得很满的日程
3. Do younger and older people like similar evening
activities?
年轻人与年长者喜欢的晚间活动相似吗？ 先承认共同爱好，
再把不同选择联系到作息和体力而非年龄定论。
There is plenty of overlap: both groups may enjoy
dinner, television or meeting friends. Differences often
concern timing and energy rather than the activity itself.
Someone working early the next day might prefer a quiet
evening, regardless of age. Younger people may go out
later, but plenty of older people enjoy lively social
events too.
两者有很多相同之处，都可能喜欢吃饭、看电视或见朋友。
区别常在时间和精力，而不是活动本身。无论多大，第二天
要早起工作的人可能更想安静度过。年轻人也许出门更晚，
但不少长者同样喜欢热闹聚会。
regardless of age 不论年龄
4. Why does leisure time with friends matter?
为什么与朋友共度闲暇时间很重要？ 用没有任务压力的相处
解释放松和信任，避免只笼统说有益身心。
It gives people a chance to relate to each other without a
task hanging over them. At work, conversations may
stay focused on deadlines, while a casual meal allows
worries and jokes to come out naturally. These small
exchanges help friends notice when someone needs
support, even before that person directly asks for it.
这让人们有机会在没有任务压着的情况下相处。工作时，话
题可能总围绕截止时间；随意吃顿饭时，担忧和玩笑就能自
然说出来。这些小交流能让朋友察觉谁需要支持，甚至不必
等对方主动开口。
a casual meal 轻松随意的一餐
5. How are people's evenings different from those in
the past?
与过去相比，人们度过晚上的方式有什么变化？ 比较在家娱
乐的选择和外出安排的便利，同时避免认为所有人相同。
Evenings now offer more activities that people can
choose individually, especially through phones and
streaming services. A family may sit in one room while
watching completely different things. Arranging
activities outside the home has also become easier
through group chats. The extra choice is useful, although
shared evening routines can require more deliberate
effort.
现在晚上有更多个人化的选择，手机和流媒体尤其如此。一
家人可能坐在同一个房间，却看着完全不同的内容。群聊也
使约外出活动更容易。选择多很方便，不过一家人固定共度
晚间时光可能更需要主动安排。
shared evening routines 共同保持的晚间安排

sections.title: 庆祝派对
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
66
话题 57
PART 2
庆祝派对
A celebration party
Describe a party you attended to celebrate something.
描述你参加过的一次庆祝聚会。
1. Where the celebration was held
聚会在哪里举行
2. What people were celebrating
庆祝什么事情
3. What took place at the party
聚会上发生了什么
4. How you felt about the occasion
你对这次聚会有何感受
审题与选材：先明确庆祝的具体原因，再挑两三个有现场感的环节，避免把整晚活动逐项报完。人物的反应比装饰和菜单更
能支撑感受。本例通过家人准备的小惊喜展示亲近，也说明为什么规模很小的聚会仍值得讲。
叙述顺序
A 说明家中为母亲举办退休聚会 - B 交代亲属分工准备食物照片 - C 讲述母亲发现照片时的反应 - D 描述饭后赠送退休建
议小本 - E 解释自己放松又感动的原因
A Introduce the retirement party at our home - B Describe relatives preparing food and old photographs - C Recall my
mother's reaction to the display - D Describe our notebook of suggestions after dinner - E Explain why I felt relaxed and
touched
示例回答
The party I'd choose was a small celebration for my mother's retirement, held in our living room last spring.
There were only ten of us, mostly relatives, so it felt more like a cheerful family dinner than a formal event. My
cousin and I arrived early to put up a string of photographs. We had pictures of my mother from different stages
of her working life, including one with a hairstyle she now finds rather embarrassing. My father cooked her
favourite dishes, and my aunt brought a homemade fruit cake. When my mother walked in, she went straight
towards the photographs. She pointed at one and started telling us about the colleague standing beside her. That
led to a whole series of stories we hadn't heard before, including how she once got locked out of the office
during her lunch break. After dinner, we gave her a small notebook in which everyone had written a suggestion
for her first month of retirement. Mine was a weekday picnic, when the park would be quiet. I felt very
comfortable at the party because there was no pressure to entertain anyone. I was also touched to see my mother
enjoying the attention, especially since she's usually the person organising everything for the rest of us.
中文对照：我会选去年春天在家里客厅为妈妈办的退休聚会。只有十个人，主要是亲属，所以更像一顿让人开心的家庭晚
餐，不是正式活动。我和表弟提前来挂照片，我们准备了妈妈工作生涯不同时期的照片，还有一张发型让她现在觉得挺不
好意思的。爸爸做了她爱吃的菜，阿姨带来自制水果蛋糕。妈妈一进门就走到照片前，指着一张讲起旁边的同事。接着，
她说了许多我们没听过的趣事，包括有次午休时被锁在办公室外。饭后，我们送给她一个小本子，每个人都写了对退休第
一个月的活动建议。我写的是工作日去野餐，那时公园比较安静。这次聚会让我很自在，不用费心招待或逗谁开心。看到
妈妈这么享受大家的关注，我也很感动，因为平时总是她为我们安排各种事情。
自然表达
put up a string of photographs
挂起一串照片
a homemade fruit cake
自制水果蛋糕
get locked out
被锁在外面
enjoy the attention
享受他人的关注
串题 话题 58 特别节日的食物
可把派对上的水果蛋糕作为食物题主角，补充材料做法与个人喜好，并解释为什么退休聚会用它庆祝，减少宾客介绍。
The fruit cake was a small part of the party, but it carried much of the celebration.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
67
话题 57  /  庆祝派对
PART 3
1. Which festivals or other occasions do people
celebrate with parties?
人们通常在哪些节日或场合举办聚会？ 区分固定节日和个人
的重要节点，各给具体场合并说明邀请对象。
People often organise parties around birthdays, weddings
and major family achievements, as well as festivals. The
guest list depends on what is being celebrated. A child's
birthday may involve classmates, whereas a
grandparent's milestone birthday brings several
generations together. Workplaces may also celebrate
completing a difficult project, giving colleagues a
chance to relax together.
生日、婚礼、重要家庭成就和节日都常有聚会。邀请谁取决
于庆祝什么。孩子生日可能邀请同学，祖父母的重要生日则
会聚齐几代人。工作场所也可能庆祝完成困难项目，让同事
有机会一起放松。
a milestone birthday 具有特别意义的生日
2. Is a party better with friends or with relatives?
聚会和朋友一起更好，还是和家人一起更好？ 让选择跟庆祝
目的对应，分别解释朋友的自在与家人的共同记忆。
It depends on the occasion. Friends may be the better
company for a casual birthday because they share your
humour and interests. A family achievement often means
more when relatives are present, since they've seen the
effort behind it. I'd choose the guests around the purpose
of the celebration rather than rank the two groups.
这取决于场合。轻松过生日时，朋友可能更合适，因为彼此
笑点和兴趣相近。庆祝家庭成就时，亲属见证过背后的努力，
他们在场往往更有意义。我会按庆祝目的选客人，而不把两
类人排出高低。
the effort behind it 背后付出的努力
3. Do parties have rules about what guests should
wear?
聚会对客人的穿着有要求吗？ 按聚会正式程度说明穿着差异，
指出查看邀请比猜测衣服贵不贵更实用。
Some do, especially weddings or formal dinners, where
the invitation may specify a dress code. At a friend's
barbecue, comfortable clothes are usually perfectly
acceptable. What matters is showing consideration for
the host and the setting. If the instructions are unclear,
asking a simple question beforehand is better than
arriving feeling awkward or overdressed.
有些有，尤其婚礼或正式晚宴，邀请上可能注明着装要求。
朋友的烧烤聚会通常穿得舒服就可以。关键是尊重主人和场
合。如果说明不清楚，提前问一句，比到了以后感到尴尬或
穿得过分正式更好。
a dress code 着装要求
4. Why are family parties held in your country?
在你的国家，人们为什么举办家庭聚会？ 用分开居住后的见
面需要解释聚会，再补充家庭传统的作用。
In China, family parties often give relatives who live
separately a reason to get together. Birthdays and
festivals create an occasion that everyone can plan
around. Sharing food also makes it easier for different
generations to talk. For some families, the gathering
matters as much as the celebration itself, particularly
when visits are otherwise rare.
在中国，家庭聚会常让分开居住的亲属有理由相聚。生日、
节日提供了大家可以提前安排的时间。一起吃饭也让几代人
更容易交流。有些家庭平时很少见面，因此聚在一起和庆祝
的事情本身同样重要。
get together 相聚
5. Do people prefer parties inside or in the open air?
人们更喜欢在室内还是户外聚会？ 比较天气保障与活动空间，
再说明安排条件不同会影响个人偏好。
Indoor parties are often easier to organise because food,
toilets and shelter are close at hand. Outdoor parties can
feel more relaxed and give children room to run around.
Weather is usually the deciding factor. A picnic sounds
wonderful on a mild day, but hosts need another plan if
rain or strong wind is likely.
室内聚会通常比较好安排，因为食物、厕所和遮风挡雨的地
方都在附近。户外聚会可能更轻松，孩子也有地方跑。天气
往往决定选择。温和天气很适合野餐，但可能下雨或刮大风
时，主人需要准备备用方案。
close at hand 就在附近；随手可得
6. Were family celebrations more common in the past
than they are now?
过去的家庭庆祝活动比现在更多吗？ 区分聚会次数和亲属是
否齐全，说明没有数据时可以谨慎比较。
I'm not sure there were more celebrations overall. In the
past, relatives living nearby could gather quite easily, so
traditional occasions may have involved more family
members. Today, distance and work schedules can make
that harder. On the other hand, some families now
celebrate additional occasions, such as graduations,
which weren't always marked with a party.
我不能确定过去庆祝的总次数更多。以前亲属住得近，容易
聚齐，传统节日也许有更多家人参加。现在距离和工作时间
会增加难度。另一方面，一些家庭如今还庆祝毕业等过去未
必专门办聚会的事情。
work schedules 工作时间安排

sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
68
话题 58
PART 2
特别节日的食物
Food for a special occasion
Describe a food you have eaten on special occasions.
描述一种你在特别场合吃过的食物。
1. What the food is
这种食物是什么
2. The occasion when you ate it
在哪种特别场合吃过
3. How people prepare it
它是怎样制作的
4. Why you enjoy eating it
你为什么喜欢吃
5. Why it is eaten on that particular occasion
人们为什么在这个场合吃它
审题与选材：这张卡有五个提示点，介绍口味不能挤掉制作方法和节日意义。选自己熟悉的食物，按家庭制作的实际顺序讲
清材料与做法。象征意义可以限定为家中的理解，不必讲未经确认的历史故事，再用一次品尝细节说明个人喜好。
叙述顺序
A 点明元宵节吃的黑芝麻汤圆 - B 说明全家晚饭后一起制作 - C 按顺序讲清和面包馅煮制 - D 描述咬开汤圆后的口感香味
- E 解释圆形与家人团聚的联系
A Name sesame rice balls for Lantern Festival - B Set the scene of making them together - C Explain mixing dough, filling
and gentle boiling - D Describe the warm filling and soft texture - E Connect their round shape with family togetherness
示例回答
A food I associate with special occasions is tangyuan, or sweet rice balls. My family usually eats them on the
evening of the Lantern Festival, and my favourites have a black sesame filling. Last time, we made a batch at
my grandmother's home after dinner. She mixed glutinous rice flour with warm water until it became a soft
dough. We divided it into small pieces, pressed a little hollow into each one, added the sesame filling and
carefully closed the dough around it. That last part was harder than it looked. One of mine split, so we patched it
with a tiny extra piece. We cooked them gently in a saucepan of water. When they were ready, my grandmother
served them in small bowls with some of the hot water. I love the contrast between the soft outside and the
warm, slightly grainy filling. I always wait before taking a bite because the centre can be surprisingly hot. In my
family, their round shape represents being together. Making them also gives everyone a small job at the same
table. So although we could buy frozen ones throughout the year, eating our own imperfect rice balls on that
particular evening feels quite different.
中文对照：让我想到特别场合的食物是汤圆。我们家通常在元宵节晚上吃，我最喜欢黑芝麻馅。上一次元宵节，我们吃过
晚饭后，在奶奶家一起做了一批汤圆。她把糯米粉和温水揉成软面团。我们分成小块，每块按出小窝，放进芝麻馅，再小
心封口。最后一步比看起来难，我包的一个裂开了，只好补上一小块面团。我们把它们放进装了水的锅里，小心地慢慢煮，
熟后奶奶把汤圆和一点热水盛进小碗。我喜欢柔软外皮和温热、略带颗粒的馅料之间的口感对比。每次吃之前，我总会先
等一会儿才咬上一口，因为里面可能非常烫。在我们家，圆形代表团聚。制作时每个人也能围着同一张桌子做点事情。虽
然全年都买得到速冻汤圆，但在那个特别的晚上吃自己做得不太完美的汤圆，感觉还是很不一样。
自然表达
a black sesame filling
黑芝麻馅
make a batch
做一批
a soft dough
柔软的面团
take a bite
咬一口
串题 话题 57 庆祝派对
可以保留元宵节、奶奶家和汤圆，改写时补上明确的庆祝聚会与其他活动；制作汤圆成为聚会的一环，不再占满全文。
Making the rice balls was only one part of the celebration we shared at my grandmother’s home.

69
话题 58  /  特别节日的食物
PART 3
1. Why do certain foods belong to particular
celebrations?
为什么某些食物会与特定庆祝活动联系在一起？ 从重复食用
形成共同记忆切入，说明节日象征和一起制作的两种作用。
Special foods help people recognise an occasion through
taste and shared memories. Sometimes their shape or
name also carries a meaning that families explain to
children. Preparing them together can be part of the
celebration itself. Even a fairly simple dish feels special
when people expect to eat it with particular relatives
once a year.
特别食物让人通过味道和共同记忆认出某个节日。有时它的
形状或名字也带有含义，家人会讲给孩子听。一起制作本身
就可能是庆祝的一部分。即使一道简单的菜，每年固定和特
定亲人吃，也会显得特别。
shared memories 共同的回忆
2. How does what people eat today differ from food in
the past?
如今人们吃的食物与过去有什么不同？ 比较日常食材选择与
备餐方式，不把新旧食物直接等同于健康好坏。
People often have access to a wider range of ingredients
now, including foods from other regions. Convenience
also plays a bigger role, with ready meals and delivery
replacing some home cooking. That doesn't make every
modern meal worse. Someone can prepare a varied
dinner more easily, but they can also rely too heavily on
processed food.
现在人们往往能买到更多食材，包括来自其他地区的食物。
便利性也更重要，预制餐和外卖取代了部分家庭烹饪。这不
表示现代饮食都更差。人们更容易做出丰富晚餐，也可能过
度依赖加工食品。
a wider range of ingredients 更多种类的食材
3. Do people in different regions eat the same special
foods every day?
不同地区的人每天都吃同样的特色食物吗？ 同时回应地区差
异和每天食用两点，避免只回答节日食物种类。
No, regional dishes vary with local ingredients and
tastes, and special dishes aren't necessarily eaten daily. A
food associated with a place might take too much time to
prepare for an ordinary weekday. People there may still
eat simple noodles or vegetables most evenings.
Restaurants and celebrations make local specialities
more visible than everyday meals do.
不会，地方菜会随当地食材和口味而变化，特色菜也不一定
每天吃。某种代表当地的菜可能很费工，不适合普通工作日。
当地人平时晚上也许只吃简单面条或蔬菜。餐馆和庆祝活动
让特色菜比日常饭菜更显眼。
local specialities 地方特色食物
4. What kinds of cuisine are popular with people in
China?
中国人喜欢哪些种类的菜肴？ 承认口味多样，列出不同做法
并说明个人习惯比国籍更具体。
There isn't one taste that represents everyone in China.
Some people love spicy hotpot, while others prefer
lighter soups, steamed fish or simple noodle dishes.
Familiar regional cooking is often comforting because
people grew up with it. Younger diners may also enjoy
trying international food, but preferences still vary
greatly within the same family.
中国并没有一种口味能代表所有人。有人爱辣火锅，有人喜
欢清淡汤品、蒸鱼或简单面食。熟悉的家乡菜常让人安心，
因为从小就在吃。年轻食客也可能喜欢尝试外国料理，但同
一家人的偏好仍会很不同。
regional cooking 地方菜肴

70
话题 58  /  特别节日的食物
PART 3
5. How is festival food different from ordinary daily
food?
节日食物与日常食物有哪些区别？ 比较制作投入、数量和象
征意义，同时允许同一道菜两种场合都出现。
Everyday food is usually chosen for convenience, cost
and keeping people fed. Festival food often takes more
preparation and may have a symbolic role, so families
make an effort even when it's time consuming. Portions
can also be larger because guests are expected. The same
dish can serve both purposes, depending on how it is
presented.
日常饭菜通常考虑方便、花费和吃饱。节日食物往往准备更
久，也可能有象征意义，所以再费时间家人也愿意做。因为
预计有客人，分量也可能更大。同一道菜也能两种场合都吃，
区别在于怎样安排。
make an effort 花心思；付出努力
6. What are the good and bad points of cooking at
home?
在家做饭有哪些优点和缺点？ 把食材控制与时间清理对应起
来，说明优势也取决于生活条件。
Cooking at home gives people more control over
ingredients, portions and spending. It can also be
enjoyable when several people help. The downside is the
time spent shopping, preparing food and cleaning
afterwards. For someone working long hours, cooking
every evening may feel like another job, especially if
they have to do everything alone.
在家做饭能更好地掌握食材、分量和开销。如果有人一起帮
忙，也很有乐趣。缺点是采购、准备和收拾都花时间。工作
时间长的人，尤其独自负责所有步骤时，每晚做饭可能感觉
像又多了一份工作。
have to do everything alone 不得不独自完成所有事情
7. Would you rather eat at home or go out for a
meal?
你更愿意在家吃饭还是外出就餐？ 明确个人平日的就餐偏好，
再用普通工作日和朋友聚餐说明例外。
Most days, I'd rather eat at home because I can make
something simple and choose how much to serve. I also
like eating without feeling that I should leave the table
quickly. Going out is a treat when friends are visiting or
I want a dish that's difficult to cook in my small kitchen.
大多数时候我更愿意在家吃，因为可以给自己做些简单的饭
菜，也能自己决定分量。我还喜欢不必觉得要赶快离开餐桌。
朋友来访，或想吃在小厨房里难做的菜时，外出吃饭对我就
是一种享受。
eat at home 在家吃饭

sections.title: 微笑的场合
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
71
话题 59
PART 2
微笑的场合
An occasion full of smiles
Describe an occasion when you saw many people smiling.
描述一次许多人都在微笑的场合。
1. When the occasion took place
这个场合发生在什么时候
2. Who was with you
你和谁在一起
3. What happened there
当时发生了什么
4. Why so many people were smiling
为什么那么多人在微笑
审题与选材：微笑题需要说明引发笑容的具体事情，而不是只写气氛很好。先交代大家聚在一起做什么，再描写一个所有人
都能看见的小动作，接着写参与者的反应。情绪可以是轻松或欣慰，不必把微笑都写成大笑。
叙述顺序
A 交代去年夏天与姐姐去社区运动会 - B 说明孩子们准备端球竞走比赛 - C 描述孩子帮助摔倒的参赛者起身 - D 写出观众
与孩子脸上的笑容 - E 解释大家为何放下胜负心
A Introduce the community games last summer - B Describe the children preparing for a race - C Recall one child helping a
fallen competitor - D Show the smiles among children and spectators - E Explain how kindness mattered more than winning
示例回答
I saw a lot of smiling faces at a small community sports afternoon last summer. I went with my sister to watch
her six-year-old son, Leo, take part. The event was held on the playground beside our neighbourhood centre,
with parents sitting around the edge on folding chairs. The nicest moment happened during a children's race.
They had to carry a soft ball on a plastic plate, walk around a cone and come back. Leo was concentrating so
hard that he barely looked up. Just ahead of him, another child dropped his ball and stumbled onto his knees.
Instead of passing him, Leo put down his own plate and helped the boy stand up. Then they picked up both balls
and walked back together. By then, neither was going to win, but hardly anyone seemed to care. The parents
started clapping, the organiser gave both children a thumbs up, and the boy who had fallen began smiling too.
My sister was smiling so widely that she forgot to take the photograph she'd been preparing for. I think people
responded to that simple, unplanned kindness. We had arrived expecting a competition, but suddenly the result
didn't matter very much. Everyone just seemed pleased that the children were enjoying themselves and looking
after each other.
中文对照：去年夏天的一次社区运动下午场，我看到许多笑脸。我和姐姐去看她六岁的儿子里奥参加活动。地点是社区中
心旁的操场，家长们坐在操场周围一圈的折叠椅上。最温暖的一幕发生在儿童比赛中：孩子要用塑料盘端着软球，绕过锥
桶再回来。里奥非常专注，几乎不抬头。前面一个孩子掉了球，还跪倒在地。里奥没有超过他，而是放下自己的盘子，扶
他起来。两人捡起球，一起走回来。这时两人都不可能获胜了，但几乎没人在意。家长鼓掌，组织者向两个孩子竖起拇指，
摔倒的小男孩也笑了。姐姐笑得太开心，连原本准备拍的照片都忘了。我想大家是被这份简单、没有预先安排的善意打动
了。原本来看比赛，结果却突然不重要了。大家看到孩子们尽情玩耍，并且愿意互相照顾，就觉得高兴。
自然表达
take part
参加
a children's race
儿童比赛
give someone a thumbs up
向某人竖起拇指表示赞许
look after each other
互相照顾
串题 话题 81 现场观看体育比赛
这场社区儿童比赛本就是现场观赛经历，可保留端球规则和孩子互助；转题时补清比赛时间与现场感受，微笑成为一个细节。
The race I watched was a small community event, but one moment made it especially enjoyable to watch.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
72
话题 59  /  微笑的场合
PART 3
1. Are people who smile frequently necessarily
friendlier?
经常微笑的人一定更友好吗？ 区分第一印象和真实待人方式，
用愿意帮助比表情更可靠来解释。
They often appear friendlier because a smile makes
approaching them feel less risky. But it doesn't tell us
everything about their character. A quiet person with a
serious expression may be very considerate once you
know them. I'd judge friendliness more by whether
someone listens and offers help than by how often they
smile.
他们给人的第一印象往往显得更友好，因为微笑让人更敢接
近。但这不能说明全部性格。一个安静、表情严肃的人，熟
悉之后可能非常体贴。我会更多看对方是否倾听、愿意帮助，
而不只看微笑次数。
a serious expression 严肃的表情
2. Why do people usually smile when a photograph is
taken?
拍照时人们为什么通常会笑？ 解释照片想留下的记忆和拍摄
习惯，补充自然笑容未必强求。
Usually, they want the photograph to represent a
pleasant moment. Smiling is also a familiar instruction,
so people do it almost automatically when someone
raises a camera. At a family gathering, it helps everyone
look connected and relaxed. Still, a natural photograph
of people talking can sometimes capture the occasion
better than a perfectly arranged smile.
通常，人们希望照片表现愉快的时刻。微笑也是熟悉的拍照
指令，所以有人举起相机时，大家几乎自动就笑了。家庭聚
会里，这能让人显得亲近放松。不过自然聊天的抓拍，有时
比刻意摆好的笑容更能记录当时。
capture the occasion 记录当时的场景与气氛
3. Do women smile more often than men, and what
might explain this?
女性是否比男性更常微笑？可能是什么原因？ 避免把性别差
异当定律，用社会期待解释可能观察到的现象。
I wouldn't assume that every woman smiles more than
every man. In some settings, women may feel stronger
pressure to appear pleasant, while men may be
encouraged to look serious. That could affect what we
notice. Personality, comfort and the situation probably
explain a great deal too, especially when people are
among close friends.
我不会认为每位女性都比男性笑得多。在某些场合，女性可
能更感到要表现亲切，男性则可能被鼓励显得严肃，这会影
响我们的观察。性格、自在程度和情境同样很重要，尤其和
亲密朋友在一起时。
feel pressure to 感到必须做某事的压力
4. Do people tend to smile more in youth or in old
age?
人们年轻时还是年长时更常微笑？ 把笑容与实际处境联系起
来，说明年龄不能单独决定快乐表达。
It's difficult to separate age from people's circumstances.
Children may smile openly during play, while older
adults may smile more quietly during a conversation.
Stress, health and companionship can affect either group.
An older person surrounded by friends may seem much
happier than a young person worrying about exams, so
age alone isn't a useful rule.
很难把年龄和生活处境分开。孩子玩耍时可能笑得很外露，
长者聊天时可能笑得比较安静。压力、健康和陪伴都会影响
两者。有朋友围绕的长者，可能比担心考试的年轻人更开心，
因此不能只按年龄判断。
age alone 单凭年龄
5. How important is smiling in your culture?
微笑在你的文化中有多重要？ 说明微笑在日常礼貌中的作用，
再指出正式或悲伤场合需要看情境。
In my experience, smiling is an important part of
showing warmth and putting people at ease. You might
smile when greeting a neighbour or thanking someone
for a small favour. It isn't appropriate in exactly the same
way everywhere, though. During a serious discussion,
listening respectfully can matter more than keeping a
cheerful expression.
按我的经验，微笑是表达亲切、让人放松的重要方式。和邻
居打招呼或感谢小帮助时，人们可能会笑。不过各个场合并
不完全适用同一种笑容。严肃讨论时，尊重地倾听可能比一
直保持开心表情更重要。
put people at ease 让人放松自在
6. When might people feel they have to smile even if
they do not mean it?
哪些时候人们可能不得不强颜欢笑？ 选择礼貌和工作两种情
境，说明微笑有时是避免冲突而非开心。
People sometimes do that to protect someone else's
feelings or keep an interaction calm. Receiving a gift
they don't particularly like is one example. Customer
service workers may also smile while dealing with a
difficult complaint. It can help in the moment, but
expecting someone to hide discomfort throughout the
day can be emotionally tiring.
人们有时为了顾及他人感受，或让交流保持平和而这样做。
例如收到并不太喜欢的礼物时。客服人员处理棘手投诉也可
能微笑。这在当下有帮助，但要求一个人整天掩饰不舒服，
会让人情绪上疲惫。
protect someone's feelings 顾及某人的感受
sections.prompt: Describe an occasion when you saw many people smiling.
questions: Are people who smile frequently necessarily friendlier?
Why do people usually smile when a photograph is taken?

sections.title: 见了一面却想继续了解的人
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
73
话题 60
PART 2
见了一面却想继续了解的人
Someone I met just once
Describe someone you met only once recently but would like to know better.
描述一位最近只见过一面、但你想进一步了解的人。
1. Who this person is
这个人是谁
2. When you met
你们什么时候见面
3. Why you would like to learn more about this person
为什么想进一步了解对方
4. How you feel about this person
你对这个人的感觉
审题与选材：必须保留最近只见一面的限制，不能随后讲成长期朋友。用一次短交流展示吸引你的具体地方，再把好奇的问
题说清楚。本例从修理物品聊到工作经历，兴趣来自对方怎样观察和解释事情，结尾可表达再次见面的期待。
叙述顺序
A 交代上个月修理活动初次见面 - B 介绍对方负责修理小家电 - C 讲清台灯故障与他的处理 - D 说明还想了解的经历与想
法 - E 表达亲切佩服及再聊的期待
A Set our first meeting at a repair event - B Introduce his role helping with household appliances - C Describe his patient
explanation about my lamp - D Identify the experiences I want to hear about - E Explain my respect and wish to meet again
示例回答
Last month, I met a man called Mr Han at a community repair afternoon. Residents could bring small broken
household items, and volunteers would try to fix them. I took along a desk lamp that had stopped working. Mr
Han was the volunteer at the electrical repair table. He looked about fifty and wore a faded blue apron with
several pencils in the pocket. Before touching the lamp, he asked me what had happened when it stopped
working. Then he checked it carefully and found a loose connection. What interested me was how he explained
everything. He didn't use complicated technical language or make me feel foolish for knowing very little. He
compared the connection to a loose button on a shirt, which immediately made sense to me. While he worked,
he mentioned that he used to repair equipment in a factory and had started volunteering after changing jobs. We
only talked for about fifteen minutes, and I haven't seen him since. I'd like to know more about the unusual
things he's repaired and why he enjoys teaching strangers. I felt comfortable around him almost immediately,
and I admired his patience. If there's another repair afternoon, I hope to go back, perhaps to help organise the
tables and hear a few more of his stories.
中文对照：上个月，我在社区维修活动中认识了韩先生。居民可以带来坏掉的小物件，由志愿者尝试修理。我带了一盏不
亮的台灯。他负责电器维修，看起来五十岁左右，穿着褪色的蓝围裙，口袋里插着几支铅笔。他先问台灯坏时发生了什么，
再仔细检查，发现连接处松了。让我感兴趣的是他的解释方式：不用复杂术语，也没让我因懂得少而难堪。他把松动的连
接比成衣服上的松纽扣，我一下就明白了。修理时，他说以前在工厂维修设备，换工作后开始做志愿者。我们只聊了十五
分钟左右，此后没有再见。我想了解他修过哪些特别的东西，也想知道他为什么喜欢教陌生人。和他相处很快就觉得自在，
也佩服他的耐心。如果还有维修活动，我希望再去，也许帮忙摆桌子，再听听他的故事。
自然表达
take something along
随身带去某物
a loose connection
松动的连接
make sense to someone
让某人明白；说得通
feel comfortable around someone
在某人身边感到自在
串题 话题 66 一个比你年长且让你佩服的人
韩先生比自己年长，可保留修台灯时的耐心与解释方式，转题时突出已观察到的佩服理由，不把一面之缘改成多年相识。
Although I met him only once, his patient way of explaining things gave me a clear reason to admire him.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
74
话题 60  /  见了一面却想继续了解的人
PART 3
1. How can we make a positive impression when
meeting someone new?
初次见面时怎样给人留下好印象？ 将好印象落到倾听和尊重
上，用追问对方内容代替自我展示。
Being attentive is usually more effective than trying to
sound impressive. Put your phone away, introduce
yourself clearly and respond to what the other person
actually says. A relevant follow-up question shows
genuine interest. Small signs of respect, such as
remembering their name, can make a brief meeting feel
comfortable without turning it into a performance.
专心通常比努力显得出众更有效。收起手机，清楚介绍自己，
并回应对方实际说的内容。针对内容继续问一句，能显示真
正的兴趣。记住名字等小小的尊重，可以让短暂见面舒服自
然，不必变成刻意表现。
a follow-up question 根据前面内容继续追问的问题
2. Which subjects are best avoided in a first
conversation?
初次交谈时最好避免哪些话题？ 从私人边界说明不宜追问的
原因，允许对方主动提及后再适度回应。
I'd avoid pushing for private information, such as
someone's income, relationship problems or reasons for
not having children. Those questions can make a
stranger feel judged before any trust exists. It's safer to
start with the shared situation or everyday interests. If
they volunteer something personal, you can respond
sensitively without demanding further details.
我会避免追问收入、感情问题或为何没有孩子等隐私。在尚
无信任时，这类问题可能让陌生人觉得被评判。先聊共同场
景或日常兴趣更稳妥。如果对方主动谈私事，可以体贴回应，
但不必继续索要细节。
private information 私人信息
3. How do people generally form friendships in
China?
中国人通常怎样建立友谊？ 用反复见面的场所解释熟悉过程，
再补充兴趣群体的认识方式。
Many friendships begin through repeated contact at
school, university or work. People become familiar with
each other before suggesting a meal or another activity
outside that setting. Introductions through existing
friends are common too. Interest groups offer another
route, because having something specific to do together
can make the first few conversations much less
awkward.
许多友谊始于学校、大学或工作中的反复接触。人们先逐渐
熟悉，再约饭或做场景之外的活动。通过现有朋友介绍也常
见。兴趣小组是另一种途径，因为一起有具体事情可做，最
初几次聊天就没那么尴尬。
repeated contact 反复接触
4. In what situations are people most willing to make
new friends?
人们在什么场合更愿意结交新朋友？ 解释新环境带来的结交
需要，同时说明持续活动比一次偶遇更容易。
People are often open to new friendships when they
enter a new stage of life, like starting university or
moving neighbourhoods. They need company and
practical support. Regular activities, such as a weekly
class, are helpful because people meet repeatedly. A
single party can start a conversation, but familiarity
usually needs more time to develop.
进入新阶段时，例如上大学或搬到新社区，人们通常更愿意
交朋友，因为需要陪伴和实际帮助。每周课程这类固定活动
很有用，能反复见到同一批人。一场聚会能开启聊天，但熟
悉往往还需要时间积累。
a new stage of life 人生的新阶段
5. How important are shared interests when choosing
friends?
交朋友时，共同兴趣有多重要？ 分清开启交流与维持信任的
作用，用兴趣不同仍能相处作补充。
Shared interests help at the beginning because they
provide easy topics and reasons to meet. Two people
who enjoy hiking can quickly arrange something
together. But similar hobbies don't guarantee a good
friendship. Reliability and respect become more
important over time, and friends with different interests
can still enjoy listening to each other's experiences.
共同兴趣在开始时很有用，能提供轻松的话题和见面理由。
两个人都喜欢徒步，就很容易约活动。但爱好相近不保证友
谊好。随着时间推移，可靠和尊重更重要，兴趣不同的朋友
也能喜欢听彼此的经历。
shared interests 共同兴趣
6. What qualities define a true friend?
真正的朋友应具备哪些品质？ 用守信和诚实解释可靠，避免
把真朋友写成无条件同意的人。
A true friend is dependable, honest and willing to pay
attention when things aren't going well. That doesn't
mean agreeing with every decision you make.
Sometimes a good friend tells you something
uncomfortable, but does it with care. Keeping a private
conversation private is another basic quality, because
trust disappears quickly when personal stories become
gossip.
真正的朋友可靠、诚实，在你不顺时也愿意认真关心。这不
意味着同意你的每个决定。有时好朋友会说让你不舒服的话，
但表达时顾及你。替私人谈话保密也很基本，因为个人故事
变成八卦时，信任会很快消失。
pay attention 认真关注

sections.title: 听不感兴趣的话题
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
75
话题 61
PART 2
听不感兴趣的话题
Listening to an unfamiliar interest
Describe a time when you continued listening to someone discussing a subject that did not interest
you.
描述一次对方聊的话题你并不感兴趣，但你仍继续听的经历。
1. Who was speaking
说话的人是谁
2. What the person talked about
对方谈了什么
3. Why you kept listening
你为什么继续听
4. How you felt about the experience
你对这次经历有何感受
审题与选材：要保留对话题不感兴趣这一前提，不必为了积极结尾突然变成爱好者。先写自己听不懂或难投入的原因，再解
释为什么愿意继续听。通过一个追问把专业细节转成对方的个人经历，感受可以从无聊变成理解。
叙述顺序
A 交代同事午休分享钓鱼经历 - B 说明专业器材让我难以投入 - C 解释他热情分享所以继续听 - D 通过一个问题转向家庭
回忆 - E 说明仍不爱钓鱼但理解对方
A Introduce my colleague talking during our lunch - B Explain why the equipment details lost me - C Describe why his
enthusiasm kept me listening - D Show how one question changed the conversation - E Separate my unchanged hobby
preference from understanding
示例回答
A few months ago, my colleague Chen spent our lunch break telling me about fishing. We'd sat down in the
small courtyard behind our office, and he had just returned from a weekend trip with his father. At first, he
explained the differences between several kinds of fishing line and showed me photographs of equipment on his
phone. I honestly couldn't follow much of it. I'd never been fishing and assumed it was mostly about collecting
equipment. I kept listening because he seemed unusually excited. He's normally rather quiet at work, so I didn't
want to shut down the first long conversation he'd started with me. I asked whether he had always enjoyed
fishing, and that question changed the direction of the conversation. He told me his father had taught him as a
child. Now they lived in different towns, and these trips were one of the few chances they had to spend a whole
day together. Suddenly, I understood why the weekend mattered so much to him. I was a little bored at the
beginning, but I felt glad I'd stayed engaged. I'm still not particularly interested in fishing equipment. What I
appreciated was hearing a side of my colleague's life that would never come up in an ordinary work meeting.
中文对照：几个月前，同事小陈几乎用了整个午休和我聊钓鱼。我们坐在办公室后的小院里，他刚和父亲周末出游回来。
起初，他向我详细解释好几种不同鱼线之间的区别，还用手机展示装备照片。说实话，他讲的内容，我其实大部分都不太
跟得上。我从没钓过鱼，总以为这项爱好主要就是收集、研究各种器材。我继续听，是因为他难得这么兴奋。他平常在单
位很安静，我不想打断他第一次主动和我长聊。我问他是不是一直喜欢钓鱼，话题就变了。他说小时候父亲教他钓鱼，如
今两人住在不同城镇，这样的旅行是少数能一起待一整天的机会。我突然理解了那个周末为何对他那么重要。一开始我有
点无聊，后来庆幸自己认真听了下去。我仍不特别喜欢钓鱼装备，但很高兴了解到同事生活中平常工作会议不会谈起的一
面。
自然表达
follow the conversation
听懂并跟上对话
shut down a conversation
使谈话中断
change the direction of the conversation
改变谈话走向
stay engaged
保持投入
串题 话题 117 改变观点的经历
可沿用同事的钓鱼谈话，明确原先以为重在收集器材，听到父子相聚后改变理解；不必假装自己因此也喜欢上钓鱼。
I had assumed fishing was mainly about equipment, but his story showed me why those trips mattered personally.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
76
话题 61  /  听不感兴趣的话题
PART 3
1. What subjects do young people enjoy discussing
these days?
如今的年轻人喜欢聊哪些话题？ 区分共同娱乐和生活压力两
类话题，避免把所有年轻人等同网民。
Entertainment, relationships and plans for the future
often come up, although young people aren't one
uniform group. Students may discuss exams or games,
while those starting work talk about housing and difficult
colleagues. Online content supplies plenty of
conversation starters, but the most meaningful
discussions usually connect with something happening
in their own lives.
娱乐、关系和未来计划常会被聊到，不过年轻人并不是完全
相同的一群。学生可能谈考试或游戏，刚工作的人会谈住房
和难相处的同事。网上内容提供许多开场话题，但最有意义
的讨论通常与自己的生活有关。
conversation starters 开启谈话的话题
2. What may happen when someone does not listen
attentively?
如果听者不认真听，会发生什么？ 分别写信息遗漏和关系受
损，用重复解释带来的感受说明后果。
They may miss important information or respond to
something the speaker never meant. In a practical
setting, that can lead to mistakes, such as arriving at the
wrong place. It also affects the relationship. If someone
repeatedly has to explain the same point, they may feel
their time and feelings aren't being taken seriously.
听者可能漏掉重要信息，或回应一个说话者根本没表达的意
思。实际安排中，这会导致走错地点等错误，也会影响关系。
如果一个人总得重复解释同一点，就可能觉得自己的时间和
感受没有受到认真对待。
be taken seriously 受到认真对待
3. How can you tell whether someone is really
listening?
怎样判断对方是否真的认真在听？ 不要只看对方的眼神和点
头，要看能否回应细节并提出相关问题。
Their responses usually show it more clearly than
constant nodding does. An attentive listener asks
relevant questions, remembers details and checks
anything they haven't understood. Eye contact can help,
but people differ in how comfortable they find it.
Someone looking away briefly may still be listening
carefully, while someone staring at you may be
completely distracted.
对方的回应通常比不停点头更能说明问题。认真听的人会问
相关问题、记住细节，并确认没听懂的地方。眼神交流有帮
助，但每个人对此的自在程度不同。短暂看向别处的人可能
仍很专心，一直盯着你的人却可能完全走神。
ask relevant questions 提出相关的问题

sections.title: 朋友很久不回你消息的经历
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
朋友、聚会与互相帮助
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
77
话题 62
PART 2
朋友很久不回你消息的经历
Waiting for a reply
Describe an occasion when a friend took a long time to answer your message.
描述一次朋友很久没有回复你消息的经历。
1. Who the friend was
是哪位朋友
2. When this happened
发生在什么时候
3. Why the reply was delayed
对方为什么迟迟没回
4. How you felt while waiting and afterwards
等待时和事后的感受
审题与选材：时间线要让读者听得出等了多久，也要区分等待时的猜测与后来知道的真实原因。选一个回复会影响实际安排
的情境，解释焦急从何而来。结果揭晓后写感受怎样改变，不要直接把延迟回复等同于故意忽视。
叙述顺序
A 交代周五向朋友确认周末计划 - B 说明半天未回影响订票安排 - C 描述反复查看手机时的猜测 - D 交代朋友值班手机没
电的原因 - E 说明释然后怎样调整联系办法
A Introduce my message about our weekend plans - B Explain why waiting affected our ticket booking - C Describe my
increasingly worried checks for replies - D Reveal his busy shift and empty battery - E Explain my relief and our new
arrangement
示例回答
One Friday afternoon last winter, I messaged my friend Hao to check whether he still wanted to visit a small
photography exhibition with me. We needed to book an entry time, so I hoped he'd reply before the evening. By
six o'clock, there was still no answer. I checked our chat several times and began wondering whether he'd
changed his mind but didn't want to say so. We'd discussed the exhibition quite enthusiastically earlier that
week, which made the silence feel confusing. I sent one short follow-up message saying I would wait until the
next morning before booking. I didn't keep sending questions, although I was tempted to. Eventually, he replied
at around ten that night. He'd been covering an extra shift at the café where he worked, and his phone had run
out of battery. He hadn't brought his charger either. As soon as he explained, I felt much better and slightly
embarrassed about the story I'd created in my head. We booked our tickets the following morning and had a
good afternoon at the exhibition. Since then, I've tried to separate a delayed reply from a lack of interest. We
also agreed that if a plan needs a quick decision, we'll make that clear in the first message.
中文对照：去年冬天一个周五下午，我发了一条消息，向朋友小浩确认，还要不要周末一起看一个小型摄影展。因为要预
约入场时间，我希望他晚上前回复。到了六点仍没消息。我反复看聊天，开始猜他是不是改变主意，又不好意思说。那周
早些时候我们聊得很兴奋，所以突然沉默让我困惑。我又补发了一条很简短的跟进消息，说等到次日早上再订票。虽然很
想继续问，我没有连发。晚上十点左右，他终于回复：他在工作的咖啡馆多顶了一班，手机没电，又没带充电器。他解释
后，我心里立刻就轻松了许多，也为脑中编出的情节有点不好意思。我们第二天订好票，愉快地看了展。此后，我尽量不
把迟回消息当成没兴趣。我们也约好，如果某个计划需要我们尽快作出决定，就在第一条消息里说清楚。
自然表达
change one's mind
改变主意
a follow-up message
补充或跟进的消息
run out of battery
电池电量耗尽
a delayed reply
延迟的回复
串题 话题 117 改变观点的经历
同一段等回复的经历可转为改变看法，明确原先以为朋友没兴趣，后来得知值班与没电，再说明判断如何改变及原因。
Once I understood what had happened during his shift, I changed my mind about what his silence meant.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
78
话题 62  /  朋友很久不回你消息的经历
PART 3
1. Would you rather send a text or make a phone
call?
你更喜欢发文字消息还是打电话？ 明确日常偏好，再按紧急
程度和信息复杂度说明何时改用电话。
For everyday arrangements, I prefer texting because the
other person can reply when they're free, and the details
remain easy to check. Calling is better when something
is urgent or difficult to explain in writing. If we're trying
to find each other at a crowded station, a short call can
save ten confusing messages.
日常安排我更喜欢发文字，对方有空时再回，约定中的具体
细节以后也方便重新查看。遇到急事或文字难解释的内容，
电话更好。如果在拥挤车站找彼此，打个简短电话可能省下
十条让人困惑的消息。
everyday arrangements 日常事务安排
2. How have people's methods of communication
changed?
人们的交流方式发生了哪些变化？ 讲信息速度与交流形式的
变化，也指出随时可联系带来的回复期待。
Communication has become quicker and more varied.
People can switch between text, voice messages and
video without arranging a meeting first. This is
especially useful for families living apart. At the same
time, being reachable so easily can create pressure to
respond immediately. People need clearer boundaries
about when they are available for conversation.
交流更快，形式也更多了。人们不用先约见面，就能在文字、
语音和视频之间切换，这对分居两地的家庭特别有用。同时，
太容易被联系到，也会带来立刻回复的压力。人们需要更清
楚地说明什么时候方便交流。
be available for conversation 有空交流
3. What makes people slow to answer messages
sometimes?
人们有时为什么回复消息很慢？ 列出忙碌与需要想清楚两种
合理原因，避免默认对方没礼貌。
Sometimes they're simply occupied with work, driving
or looking after someone. A message may also need
thought, so they leave it until they can give a proper
answer. Notifications can be missed or forgotten as well.
Without knowing the circumstances, it's risky to assume
that a slow reply is a deliberate sign of disrespect.
有些时候，他们其实只是正忙于工作、开车或照顾别人。有
些消息需要思考，对方会留到能认真回答时再处理。提醒也
可能没看到或被忘记。不了解处境时，就认定迟回是故意不
尊重人，容易判断错。
give a proper answer 给出认真完整的回答
4. Does friendship require patience?
友谊需要耐心吗？ 用不同作息解释朋友间互相体谅，再把耐
心与一味迁就清楚区分。
Yes, because friends don't always have the same energy,
schedule or way of dealing with problems. Patience
gives someone room to be busy or upset without
immediately threatening the friendship. Still, it shouldn't
mean accepting repeated hurtful behaviour. If plans are
constantly cancelled, a calm conversation is more useful
than pretending nothing bothers you.
需要，因为朋友的精力、时间和处理问题的方式不总相同。
耐心让对方忙碌或难过时有余地，不至于立刻影响友谊。不
过这不意味着接受反复伤害。如果计划总被取消，平静谈一
谈比假装毫不介意更有用。
give someone room 给某人空间
5. How do you feel if a friend seems to ignore your
message?
朋友似乎不理你的消息时，你感觉如何？ 承认失望情绪但区
分表面现象和真实动机，说明确认情况后的反应。
Initially, I feel a bit disappointed, especially if I've asked
something important. Then I try to remember that silence
doesn't tell me the reason. I usually wait rather than send
several angry messages. If it becomes a pattern, I'd ask
directly whether a different way of communicating
would work better for both of us.
起初我会有点失望，尤其问的是重要的事。随后我会提醒自
己，沉默并不能说明原因。我通常先等，而不是连发几条生
气的消息。如果总这样，我会直接问，换种联系方式是否对
我们都更合适。
become a pattern 成为反复出现的情况
6. How can friends prevent misunderstandings?
朋友之间怎样避免误会？ 把具体说清与及时确认结合，说明
文字语气不明时该怎样处理。
Being specific helps: say what you need, when you need
an answer and whether a plan is definite. It's also worth
checking your interpretation before reacting to a
message that sounds unfriendly. A quick call can clear
up tone more easily than a long argument in text. Good
intentions aren't always obvious without a little
explanation.
表达具体很有帮助：说清需要什么、何时要答复，以及计划
是否确定。遇到听着不友好的消息，先确认自己的理解再反
应也很值得。一个短电话比长篇文字争论更容易澄清语气。
好意有时也需要解释才能被看见。
clear up 澄清；消除误解

sections.titleEn: Working as part of a group
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
79
话题 63
PART 2
在团队中工作
Working as part of a group
Describe an occasion when you worked together with a group.
描述一次你与团队合作的经历。
1. What the group did
团队做了什么
2. Who you worked alongside
你和谁合作
3. The difficulties you encountered
遇到了哪些困难
4. Why the work needed to be done as a group
为什么要以团队形式完成
审题与选材：合作题必须说明为什么需要团队，不能只列每人的分工。选择一个有人手或时间限制的共同任务，再展开一处
真实分歧或疏漏。重点讲怎样沟通解决，而不是把队友写成完美搭档；结果也应让人看得出分工确实发挥了作用。
叙述顺序
A 交代四位同学一起办旧书交换 - B 说明书籍登记与现场工作分工 - C 指出标签不一导致摆放混乱 - D 讲清统一规则并重
新分类 - E 用现场顺利说明团队必要性
A Introduce our four-person secondhand book exchange team - B Explain the jobs before and during opening - C Describe
the confusion caused by inconsistent labels - D Show how we agreed on one system - E Connect the smooth event with
shared responsibilities
示例回答
During my final year at college, I worked with three classmates to organise a secondhand book exchange. We
used a spare classroom for one afternoon and invited students to bring books they no longer needed. We divided
the preparation between us. I made a simple registration form, one classmate designed a poster, and the other
two collected books from different classrooms. At first, we thought that was enough organisation. Then, the
evening before the event, we discovered that everyone had labelled the books differently. Some labels showed
the owner's name, others showed the subject, and several books had no labels at all. We were tired and started
blaming one another, but eventually we sat down and agreed on one clear system. Each book received a number,
with the owner's details recorded on a separate list. We also sorted the tables by subject so visitors could find
things easily. The next afternoon, two of us welcomed people while the others handled the exchanges and
updated the records. I remember feeling relieved when the first few transactions went smoothly. We needed to
work as a group because no single person could collect books, answer questions and keep accurate records at the
same time. The experience wasn't effortless, but sharing the jobs made the event manageable.
中文对照：大学最后一年，我和三位同学办了一次旧书交换活动。我们借用空教室一个下午，请同学带来不再需要的书。
准备时，我们先作了分工：我负责做一份简单的登记表，一人设计海报，另外两人去不同教室收书。起初觉得这样就安排
好了。活动前一晚却发现标签不统一：有的写书主姓名，另一些却写着书的科目，还有几本没标签。大家累了，开始互相
责怪，最后还是坐下来商定统一办法。每本书给一个编号，书主资料另记在清单上；桌子也按科目分区，方便找书。第二
天下午，两人接待，另外两人办理交换和更新记录。前几次交换顺利完成时，我记得自己松了一口气。这件事需要团队，
因为一个人无法同时收书、回答问题和准确记录。这次团队合作当然并不是毫不费力就能完成的，但分担工作确实让活动
变得可以完成。
自然表达
divide the preparation
分配准备工作
blame one another
互相责怪
keep accurate records
保留准确记录
go smoothly
顺利进行
串题 话题 64 帮助他人的时刻
可沿用旧书交换项目及标签混乱，但帮助题应聚焦某位同学遇到的具体困难，讲自己的检查和解决过程，减少整体分工介绍。
The group project also gave me a chance to help one classmate solve a very specific problem.
