sections.title: 喜欢拍照的人
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
学习技能与培养兴趣
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
136
话题 90
PART 2
喜欢拍照的人
Someone who loves taking photographs
Describe someone in your life who really enjoys photography.
描述一位你生活中很喜欢拍照的人。
1. Who this person is
这个人是谁
2. When and where they take photographs
对方什么时候、在哪里拍照
3. Why they enjoy taking them
你认为对方为什么喜欢拍照
4. How you feel about this person
你对这个人的感受
审题与选材：拍照习惯要有时间、地点和对象，不能只说走到哪里拍到哪里。用一次普通拍摄说明对方关注什么，再解释照
片如何被保存或使用。评价可以既欣赏他的观察力，也承认偶尔等待拍摄会不耐烦，让人物更自然。
叙述顺序
A 介绍爱拍照的朋友可欣 - B 说明她周末拍街道和聚会 - C 描述雨后拍面包店倒影 - D 讲她做相册保存日常记忆 - E 说明
自己由不耐烦转为欣赏
A Introduce Kexin, my friend who enjoys photography - B Describe her weekend streets and family gatherings - C Recall
photographing a bakery reflected after rain - D Explain her albums of small everyday memories - E Describe learning to
appreciate her patient observation
示例回答
My friend Kexin is the person I associate most with taking photographs. We met at university, and she has
carried a small camera on almost every outing we've had together. She mainly takes pictures on weekend walks
and at family gatherings. She's less interested in famous landmarks than in ordinary details: sunlight on a kitchen
wall, a shopkeeper arranging fruit or someone's hands making dumplings. One rainy afternoon, we were
walking home when she stopped outside a bakery. I thought she wanted something to eat, but she had noticed
the shop's warm lights reflected in a puddle. She crouched down, waited for a cyclist to pass and took just two
photographs. I would have walked straight past the scene. She says photographs help her remember what a
period of life actually felt like. Every few months, she prints a selection and makes a small album, adding
handwritten notes about the place or the people. She even stitches simple cloth covers for some of them. I used
to get slightly impatient when she stopped during our walks. Now I appreciate how much she notices. Her
pictures have also preserved moments I'd forgotten, like my grandfather laughing over a crooked dumpling. I
think her hobby makes her attentive to people and to the small changes around us.
中文对照：提到拍照，我最先想到朋友可欣。我们在大学认识，几乎每次一起外出，她都带着小相机。她主要在周末散步
和家庭聚会时拍照，比起名胜，她更喜欢普通细节，比如厨房墙上的阳光、店主摆水果的样子，或别人包饺子的双手。一
个雨天下午，我们回家时，她在面包店外停下。我以为她想买吃的，其实她看到了店内暖光映在水洼里。她蹲下，等骑车
人经过，只拍了两张。我本会直接走过。她说照片帮助她记住一段生活真正的感觉。每隔几个月，她会选照片打印，做成
小相册，手写地点或人物说明，有时还缝简单布封面。以前散步时她总停，我会有点不耐烦。如今我欣赏她能注意到这么
多事。她还保存了我已忘记的瞬间，比如外公对着一个歪饺子大笑。我觉得这爱好让她留意别人，也留意身边细小的变化。
自然表达
walk straight past
径直走过
a selection of photographs
精选的一组照片
get impatient
变得不耐烦
handwritten notes
手写说明
串题 话题 88 擅长做手工的人
可欣亲手缝相册封面的细节能连接制作特别物品的人题；需要补充一本相册的材料、装订和用途，不能把普通拍摄直接当作
手工。
Her handmade photo albums could fit the making topic if I describe the materials, stitching and finished object.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
学习技能与培养兴趣
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
137
话题 90  /  喜欢拍照的人
PART 3
1. What subjects do people often like to photograph?
人们通常喜欢拍哪些内容？ 从记录关系、旅行和日常兴趣分
组，说明选题与想保留的东西有关。
People often photograph family, friends, food and places
they visit. These subjects connect to experiences they
want to keep or share. Some prefer details that reflect a
hobby, such as birds, buildings or handmade objects.
The choice also depends on the occasion: a birthday
invites pictures of people, while a quiet walk may
encourage noticing scenery.
人们常拍家人、朋友、食物和去过的地方，因为这些关联着
想保留或分享的经历。有些人偏爱与爱好有关的细节，如鸟、
建筑或手工作品。选择也看场合：生日会让人拍人物，安静
散步可能让人留意风景。
keep or share 保留或分享
2. Is taking photographs acceptable in every
location?
任何地方都可以拍照吗？ 用私人空间和易受影响场所说明边
界，先观察规定再决定是否拍。
No. People should consider the setting, any clear rules
and whether photography would disturb others. A
private home, a changing room and a quiet performance
all raise different concerns. Even where photography is
allowed, using a flash or blocking a path may be
inconsiderate. Being able to take a picture doesn't always
make it appropriate.
不是。应该考虑环境、明确规则，以及是否会打扰别人。私
人住宅、更衣室和安静演出，各有不同顾虑。即使允许拍照，
开闪光灯或堵路也可能不体贴。有能力拍下一张照片，并不
总意味着适合拍。
disturb others 打扰他人
3. How do you feel about strangers appearing in
people's photos?
你怎么看照片里拍到陌生人这件事？ 区分远处偶然入镜与可
识别的近景，进一步考虑公开分享的影响。
A distant person accidentally appearing in a busy street
scene is different from making a recognisable stranger
the main subject. For a close portrait, asking first is more
considerate, especially before sharing it publicly. I'd also
avoid images that embarrass someone or reveal a private
moment. The photographer's interest shouldn't be the
only thing considered.
繁忙街景中远处有人偶然入镜，与把可辨认的陌生人作为主
角不同。拍近距离肖像时，先询问更体贴，尤其准备公开分
享前。我也会避免让人难堪或暴露私人时刻的照片。不能只
考虑摄影者的兴趣。
a private moment 私人时刻
4. Why do some people take many photos while
others hardly take any?
为什么有人爱拍照，有人却很少拍？ 比较保存记忆与专心体
验两种偏好，也考虑拍摄是否让人分心。
Some people enjoy noticing details and keeping a visual
record of their lives. Others feel that reaching for a
camera interrupts the experience they're having.
Confidence matters too: someone who dislikes their
photographs may stop trying. Neither approach means
caring more about an event. People simply have different
ways of paying attention and remembering what matters.
有些人喜欢注意细节，用影像记录生活；另一些人觉得拿相
机会打断正在经历的事情。信心也有影响，不喜欢自己照片
的人可能不再尝试。两种方式都不代表谁更在乎活动，只是
关注和记忆重要事情的方法不同。
a visual record 影像记录
5. Why is sharing photographs on social media so
common?
为什么很多人把照片分享到社交媒体？ 同时说明联系亲友和
获得回应的动机，用共同记忆解释持续分享。
Photos let people share an experience quickly with
friends who weren't there. They can keep distant
relatives involved in everyday life and give people an
easy reason to start a conversation. Some also enjoy
praise or want to present a particular image of
themselves. The same post may serve several purposes,
from preserving memories to seeking attention.
照片让人迅速向没在场的朋友分享经历，也让远方亲属参与
日常，为交谈提供轻松起点。有些人还喜欢赞美，或希望展
示某种个人形象。同一条分享可能同时有多个目的，从保存
记忆到寻求关注。
start a conversation 开启交谈

sections.title: 喜欢种植物的人
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
学习技能与培养兴趣
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
138
话题 91
PART 2
喜欢种植物的人
Someone who enjoys growing plants
Describe a person you know who likes growing plants.
描述一位你认识的、喜欢种植物的人。
1. Who the person is
这个人是谁
2. How you know them
你怎样认识对方
3. What plants they grow
对方种哪些植物
4. Why they enjoy growing plants
对方为什么喜欢种植
审题与选材：选择熟悉的人和有限几种植物，能更容易讲清日常照料。介绍关系后用一次观察表现种植过程，再把动机区分
为实用收获、安静活动或看见变化。别只罗列花名，也不要把种得好直接当作爱种植的理由。
叙述顺序
A 介绍家住父母附近的姑姑 - B 说明阳台上种薄荷豆子和花 - C 描述她早晨观察土壤和叶子 - D 讲她记录豆子发芽的变化
- E 解释她享受安静与新鲜收获
A Introduce my aunt who lives nearby - B Name her mint, beans and flowering plants - C Describe her morning checks of
soil and leaves - D Recall recording the changes in growing beans - E Explain her enjoyment of quiet and fresh harvests
示例回答
My aunt is the keenest gardener I know, even though she doesn't have a garden. She lives in a flat near my
parents, and I've visited her regularly since I was little. Her balcony is full of pots. She grows mint, a few bean
plants and several kinds of flowers. The arrangement isn't very formal: larger pots stand on the floor, while
smaller ones sit on shelves where she can reach them easily. Most mornings, she spends a few minutes checking
the plants before breakfast. She looks at the leaves and touches the soil instead of automatically watering
everything. If something has changed, she usually notices it before anyone else. Last spring, she helped me
watch beans germinate in a clear container. We took photographs as the first roots and shoots appeared. She was
just as interested as I was, although she'd grown beans many times before. I think she enjoys growing plants
partly because it gives her a quiet activity with visible progress. After a busy day, looking after the pots helps
her slow down. She also likes using a few fresh mint leaves in drinks or picking something she has grown
herself. The harvest is small, but she seems to enjoy the whole process, not just what ends up on the table.
中文对照：姑姑是我认识的人里最爱种植物的，虽然她并没有花园。她住在父母家附近的公寓里，我从小就常去。她阳台
摆满花盆，种薄荷、几株豆子和几种花。摆放并不正式，大盆在地上，小盆放在方便够到的架子上。多数早晨，她在吃饭
前花几分钟检查植物，看叶子、摸土，而不是自动给所有盆浇水。有变化时，她通常最先发现。去年春天，她帮我在透明
容器里观察豆子发芽，根和芽出现时，我们拍照记录。虽然她种过很多次豆子，仍和我一样感兴趣。我认为她喜欢种植，
部分原因是这是项安静、又能看到进展的活动。忙了一天后，照顾花盆让她慢下来。她也喜欢在饮料里放几片新鲜薄荷，
或采下自己种的东西。收成很少，但她享受的是整个过程，而不只是最后上桌的部分。
自然表达
visible progress
看得见的进展
slow down
慢下来
look after
照顾
end up on the table
最后端上餐桌
串题 话题 86 一个有趣的生物知识
姑姑观察豆子发芽的活动可以转到生物知识题；缩短人物介绍，准确说明先见根后见芽、何时怎样学到，以及这为何改变你
的观察方式。
The germination experiment could become a biology topic, with more explanation of what I observed and learned from
it.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
学习技能与培养兴趣
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
139
话题 91  /  喜欢种植物的人
PART 3
1. Is there a plant you especially enjoy growing?
你有没有特别喜欢种的植物？ 明确选择薄荷并说明容易观察
和使用的个人理由，不夸大种植效果。
I like growing mint in a pot because I can enjoy both its
smell and its leaves. It doesn't require a large garden,
which suits my living situation. I sometimes add a few
leaves to a cold drink. I'm still learning how to care for it
properly, but having a useful plant makes me pay
attention regularly.
我喜欢盆栽薄荷，因为既能闻香，也能用叶子。它不需要大
花园，适合我的居住条件。我有时会往冷饮里放几片叶子。
虽然仍在学习正确照料，但植物有实际用途，让我愿意经常
留意它。
pay attention regularly 经常留意
2. What should someone prepare before planting?
种植前需要做哪些准备？ 先看空间和植物需求，再准备容器
材料，避免先买一堆不适合的花。
I'd first check how much light and space are available,
then choose a plant suited to those conditions. After that,
I'd prepare a suitable container, growing material and a
way for excess water to drain. Reading basic care
information matters too. Buying attractive plants first
can lead to disappointment if the space cannot meet their
needs.
我会先检查光照和空间，再选适应这些条件的植物。然后准
备合适容器、栽培材料和排出多余水分的方式，也要阅读基
础养护信息。若先买漂亮植物，空间却无法满足需求，就容
易失望。
meet their needs 满足它们的需要
3. Would you describe growing plants as easy or
difficult?
你觉得种植物容易还是困难？ 区分基础上手与持续照料，说
明植物种类和个人居住条件决定难度。
It can be easy to start and harder to do consistently. A
suitable plant in a good location may need only a simple
routine, while another may be less forgiving. The
challenge is noticing changes and adjusting care rather
than following a fixed habit blindly. Choosing
something appropriate for your space makes a
considerable difference.
开始可能容易，持续做好更难。适合的植物放在合适位置，
也许只需简单照料，另一些则不太容许失误。挑战在于发现
变化并调整，而不是盲目遵循固定习惯。选择适合自己空间
的植物，差别会很大。
a simple routine 简单的日常安排
4. What can people gain from solving gardening
problems?
解决种植问题之后，人们能收获什么？ 把解决问题后的知识
与信心分开，用观察和调整说明收获的来源。
They gain practical knowledge and more confidence in
observing carefully. If a plant improves after someone
identifies a problem and changes its care, the connection
becomes memorable. They also learn patience, because
results may take time to appear. Even an unsuccessful
attempt can teach them to keep notes and change one
thing at a time.
他们能获得实际知识，也更有信心仔细观察。找到问题、改
变照料后，植物好转，这种联系就容易记住。人们还会学到
耐心，因为结果需要时间。即使没有成功，也能学着记录，
并一次只调整一件事。
one thing at a time 一次一件事


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
学习技能与培养兴趣
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
140
话题 91  /  喜欢种植物的人
PART 3
5. Do people in China enjoy gardening?
中国人喜欢园艺吗？ 以城乡空间差异说明不同种植形式，不
用笼统概括所有人的爱好。
Some certainly do, although the form depends on where
they live. People with outdoor space may grow
vegetables or flowers, while city residents might keep
pots on a balcony or windowsill. In my family, plants are
a common interest, but I wouldn't assume everyone
enjoys gardening. Limited space, time and personal
preference all influence participation.
当然有些人喜欢，但形式取决于居住环境。有户外空间的人
可能种菜或花，城市居民可能在阳台、窗台摆花盆。我家里
很多人对植物有兴趣，但不能推断人人都喜欢。空间、时间
和个人偏好都会影响参与。
outdoor space 户外空间
6. Why do people choose to grow their own produce?
人们为什么自己种水果和蔬菜？ 从新鲜、过程和选择品种说
明动机，不把小规模种植直接说成省钱。
Freshness and enjoyment are common reasons. Picking a
tomato you have watched grow can feel more satisfying
than buying one. People may also want to try varieties
that shops nearby don't sell. It isn't always cheaper,
especially with a small setup, so I think the experience
and control over what they grow often matter as much as
cost.
新鲜和乐趣是常见理由。摘下自己看着长大的番茄，可能比
买一个更有满足感。有些人想种附近商店没有的品种。小规
模种植未必便宜，因此我觉得过程体验和能自主选择种什么，
往往与成本一样重要。
as much as cost 与成本同样重要
7. Will growing plants become more popular in
future?
未来种植物的人会越来越多吗？ 给出有条件的预测，用小空
间种植便利与生活限制解释两种可能。
I think interest could grow if people have access to
suitable small-space options and clear guidance. Balcony
pots and shared gardens make participation possible
without owning a house. Still, busy schedules and
limited light can discourage people. More interest
doesn't necessarily mean everyone will keep growing
things once the first excitement of buying plants has
passed.
如果有适合小空间的选择和清晰指导，我觉得兴趣可能增长。
阳台花盆、共享花园让没有独立住宅的人也能参与。但日程
忙碌、光照有限会让人退缩。兴趣增加并不代表买植物的新
鲜感过去后，人人都会继续种。
shared gardens 共享花园
8. Should gardening be taught at school?
学校应该教学生种植吗？ 把种植与观察记录、合作相连，说
明学习不应依赖每个学生有家中花园。
Yes, a modest gardening activity can connect science
with something children can observe over time. They
can record growth, share responsibilities and see that
living things need regular attention. Schools don't need a
huge plot to begin; a few suitable containers may be
enough. The learning should focus on observation and
care, rather than producing a perfect harvest.
应该，规模不大的种植活动能把科学与长期可观察的东西联
系起来。孩子可以记录生长、分担责任，知道生命需要持续
照料。学校不必先有大块土地，几个合适容器也能开始。重
点应是观察和照顾，而非收成完美。
share responsibilities 分担责任

sections.title: 喜欢或者不喜欢的高楼
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
141
话题 92
PART 2
喜欢或者不喜欢的高楼
A high-rise building I like
Describe a tall building that you like or dislike.
描述一座你喜欢或不喜欢的高楼。
1. Where the building is
建筑在哪里
2. What it looks like
外观是什么样
3. What it is used for
它有什么用途
4. Why you like or dislike it
你喜欢或不喜欢它的原因
审题与选材：先确认建筑确实较高，并交代位置、外观和用途。喜欢或不喜欢应由使用体验支持，如等电梯、自然采光或交
通便利，而不是只评价玻璃漂亮。可以先概括整栋楼，再用一次进入其中的经历让建筑与个人感受连接。
叙述顺序
A 介绍地铁站旁的文化中心高楼 - B 说明灰色外墙与错落阳台 - C 交代图书馆教室和办公用途 - D 描述在高层阅览室看书
- E 解释喜欢采光和公共用途
A Locate the tall cultural centre beside a station - B Describe grey walls and staggered small balconies - C Explain its
library, classrooms and office spaces - D Recall reading in an upper-floor public room - E Connect my preference with
daylight and public access
示例回答
There's a tall cultural centre beside the main metro station in my town that I really like. It's about eighteen
storeys high, so it stands well above the older shops around it. The outside is mostly light grey, with wide
windows and a series of small balconies set at different levels. It isn't especially dramatic, but the broken-up
shape makes it look less like a solid block. At ground level, there's a covered area where people can wait out the
rain. The lower floors contain a public library and classrooms for community courses. Higher up, there are
offices and a public reading room overlooking the town. I first went there to return a library book, then noticed a
sign directing visitors upstairs. I spent an hour in the reading room that afternoon. The desks were close to the
windows, and I could see buses moving below without hearing much traffic. It felt bright and calm, despite
being right beside a busy station. I like the building because its height serves a practical purpose. Several useful
services fit into a small area, and ordinary residents can enjoy the views as well as the people working there. The
lifts can be slow at busy times, but overall I find it a welcoming place.
中文对照：我很喜欢镇上主地铁站旁的一座文化中心高楼。它大约十八层，比周围老商铺高出很多。外墙主要是浅灰色，
有宽窗和高低错落的小阳台。外观不算特别夸张，但分开的形状让它不像一整块厚重方块。底层有带顶的空间，可供人避
雨。较低楼层是公共图书馆和社区课程教室，高处有办公室，以及俯瞰小镇的公共阅览室。我第一次去是还图书馆的书，
后来注意到指引访客上楼的牌子。那天下午，我在阅览室待了一小时。桌子靠窗，可以看到下方公交车移动，却听不到多
少交通噪声。尽管紧邻繁忙车站，室内仍明亮安静。我喜欢它，是因为高度有实际用途：小面积里容纳多种有用服务，普
通居民和在那里工作的人一样，也能欣赏风景。忙时电梯有点慢，但整体上是个让人愿意进入的地方。
自然表达
stand above
高于；耸立于……之上
wait out the rain
等雨停
overlook the town
俯瞰小镇
serve a practical purpose
具有实际用途
串题 话题 93 想去的公共建筑
文化中心属于公共建筑，可连接想参观的建筑题；已经用过阅览室时，应说明还想看哪些未去过的楼层或设施，保持未来愿
望语气。
I already know its reading room, but I'd like to explore the community classrooms on another visit.

建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
142
话题 92  /  喜欢或者不喜欢的高楼
PART 3
1. Have you lived in a high-rise yourself?
你自己住过高楼吗？ 直接说明住过的楼层，再用景观和电梯
的日常体验形成具体回答。
Yes, I lived on the twelfth floor of an apartment building
with my parents for several years. I liked the light and
the view across nearby roofs. The main inconvenience
was waiting for the lift when everyone left for work. It
was comfortable overall, but carrying groceries upstairs
during a lift repair wasn't much fun.
住过，我和父母曾在公寓楼十二层住了几年。我喜欢光线和
越过附近屋顶的视野。主要不便是大家上班时要等电梯。总
体住得舒服，不过电梯维修时提着食品爬楼，确实不好受。
wait for the lift 等电梯
2. How can climate influence the design of buildings?
气候会怎样影响建筑设计？ 围绕炎热、寒冷和下雨分别说明
设计需要，不堆砌建筑技术参数。
Climate affects decisions about shade, insulation,
ventilation and materials. In a hot place, designers may
try to reduce direct sunlight and allow air to move
through rooms. In a cold place, keeping heat inside
becomes more important. Rain also matters, influencing
roofs and entrances. A beautiful design can be
uncomfortable if it ignores local weather.
气候影响遮阳、保温、通风和材料选择。炎热地方可能要减
少直射阳光，让空气穿过房间；寒冷地方更重视留住热量。
雨水也会影响屋顶和入口。设计再漂亮，忽视本地天气也可
能住得不舒服。
direct sunlight 直射阳光
3. Why do many people in China now live in tall
apartment buildings?
为什么现在很多中国人住在高层住宅里？ 用城市土地与服务
集中解释住房形式，不把选择全部归因个人偏好。
In crowded cities, building upwards allows more homes
to fit near jobs, schools and transport. Apartments can
also offer services shared by many households, such as
maintenance and security. People's choices are partly
shaped by what housing is available and affordable.
Living in a high-rise doesn't always mean someone
prefers it to every other type of home.
在人口密集城市，向上建能让更多住宅靠近工作、学校和交
通。公寓也可由多户共享维护、安保等服务。选择部分取决
于有哪些负担得起的住房。住高楼，并不总意味着个人更喜
欢它胜过所有其他住宅类型。
building upwards 向上建造
4. Will people in China prefer high-rise apartments
or houses in future?
未来中国人会更喜欢高层公寓还是独栋住宅？ 区分理想偏好
与实际选择，比较空间需求和通勤便利两类考虑。
I expect preferences to remain mixed. Some people will
want a house for outdoor space and greater control over
noise or layout. Others will value apartments close to
work and public transport. What they actually choose
will depend heavily on cost and location. A convenient
flat may be more appealing than a larger house requiring
a long commute.
我预计偏好仍会多样。有些人想要独栋住宅的户外空间，以
及对噪声、布局更大的控制；另一些人重视靠近工作和公交
的公寓。实际选择很大程度取决于价格和位置。方便的公寓
可能比需要长途通勤的大房子更有吸引力。
a long commute 长途通勤
5. Why do some people want to design their own
homes?
为什么有些人想自己设计住房？ 把个人需求落实为工作空间
与家庭使用，解释标准布局为何不够合适。
They may have needs that standard layouts don't meet,
such as space for a home workshop or a relative with
limited mobility. Designing a home also lets them
choose how light, storage and shared areas work
together. Personal expression matters too. Still,
professional advice is useful, because an attractive
drawing doesn't guarantee a comfortable place to live.
他们可能有标准布局满足不了的需求，比如家庭工作间，或
行动不便亲属的使用空间。自己设计也能安排采光、收纳和
公共区域的配合，同时表达个人喜好。但专业建议仍有用，
因为漂亮图纸并不保证住得舒适。
standard layouts 标准布局

sections.titleEn: A public building I want to visit
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
143
话题 93
PART 2
想去的公共建筑
A public building I want to visit
Describe a public building you hope to visit.
描述一座你想去参观的公共建筑。
1. Where it is
建筑在哪里
2. What the building is like
建筑是什么样的
3. How you heard about it
你怎样知道它的
4. Why you want to visit
你为什么想去
审题与选材：重点是想去而非已经去过，因此把朋友提供的信息和自己的期待分开。先交代位置与外观，再用阅览区和屋顶
花园说明它为何吸引你。准备一次具体的周末安排，比单纯称赞建筑漂亮更能解释参观理由。
叙述顺序
A 先说明图书馆所在的位置 - B 接着交代朋友介绍的经过 - C 描述外观和内部阅读空间 - D 安排准备参观的具体活动
- E 解释安静与开放带来的吸引
A Locate the library across the river - B Explain how a friend mentioned it - C Describe its bright and open spaces - D Plan
a few activities for Saturday - E Explain why the atmosphere attracts you
示例回答
There's a new public library across the river from my neighbourhood that I'd really like to visit. It's beside a
small park, about forty minutes from my home by bus. A friend told me about it after she went there to work on
a college project. She sent me a few photos, and the building looked much more welcoming than I expected. The
twelve-storey building has pale brick walls and huge windows. Inside, there's a wide staircase where people can
sit with books, rather than just walk between floors. My friend also mentioned a quiet reading room overlooking
the trees and a small garden on the roof. I haven't checked whether the garden is open every day, so I'd look that
up before going. I'd probably visit on a Saturday morning, choose a travel book and spend an hour reading by a
window. Then I'd explore the rest of the building and have my packed lunch in the park. What attracts me is the
combination of useful public space and thoughtful design. I often read at home, but it's easy to get distracted by
chores. Having a comfortable place where I can simply sit and concentrate sounds lovely, especially because I
wouldn't have to buy anything to stay there.
中文对照：河对岸新开了一座公共图书馆，我很想去。它紧邻小公园，从家坐公交约四十分钟。朋友去那里做大学课题后
向我推荐，还发来几张照片，建筑比我预想的更亲切。这栋十二层建筑有浅色砖墙和大窗户。里面的宽楼梯不仅通往各层，
还能坐着读书。朋友提到面向树木的安静阅览室，以及小屋顶花园。我尚未确认花园是否每天开放，去前会查。我可能周
六上午去，挑本旅行书，在窗边读一小时，再逛建筑其余部分，去公园吃自带午餐。最吸引我的是实用公共空间与用心设
计的结合。我常在家读书，却容易被家务分心。能有个舒服的地方，只需坐下专心阅读，听起来就很好，尤其无需买东西
也能一直待在那里。
自然表达
overlook the trees
面向树木
get distracted by
被……分散注意力
packed lunch
自带午餐
thoughtful design
用心的设计

The library is also a high-rise building I admire for its welcoming design and useful public spaces.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
144
话题 93  /  想去的公共建筑
PART 3
1. Do people generally prefer flats or detached
houses?
人们通常更喜欢公寓还是独栋住宅？ 先分清理想空间与实际
预算，再解释通勤为何会改变住房选择。
Many people would enjoy the extra space of a detached
house, but a flat is often a more practical choice. It can
be closer to work and easier to maintain. A young couple
might choose a small central flat over a larger house if it
saves them an hour of commuting every day.
很多人会喜欢独栋住宅多出的空间，但公寓往往更实用，离
单位可能更近，也较容易维护。年轻夫妻可能宁愿选市中心
的小公寓，而不是大房子，只要这样每天能省下一小时通勤。
a practical choice 实用的选择
2. Which kinds of historic buildings should be
protected?
哪些历史建筑值得保护？ 从能说明当地生活的建筑切入，同
时说明保护需要继续使用。
Buildings that help people understand local history
deserve protection, even if they aren't grand palaces. An
old market or railway station can show how ordinary
people lived and worked. I'd also consider whether a
building can still serve a useful purpose, because a
working community centre is easier to care for than an
empty shell.
能帮助人们了解当地历史的建筑值得保护，即使它们不是宏
伟宫殿。旧市场或车站也能展示普通人的生活和工作。我还
会考虑它能否继续发挥作用，因为仍在使用的社区中心比空
壳建筑更容易得到维护。
serve a useful purpose 发挥实际作用
3. Which public facilities are widely used in your
area?
你住的地方哪些公共设施使用较多？ 选两种日常设施，分别
说明人们在哪个时间以及怎样使用。
In my area, parks and public sports courts seem
particularly busy. Older residents walk in the park early
in the morning, while students play basketball after
school. The local library also attracts people at
weekends, especially families looking for somewhere
inexpensive to spend a few hours together when the
weather is bad.
我住的地方，公园和公共球场似乎特别热闹。老年居民清晨
到公园散步，学生放学后打篮球。图书馆周末也吸引不少人，
尤其天气不好时，家庭会找一个花费不高、能一起待几个小
时的地方。
public sports courts 公共球场
4. Do young and older people use similar public
facilities?
年轻人和老年人使用的公共设施相似吗？ 同一公园可供不同
活动，区别应落在使用方式而非绝对分组。
There is quite a lot of overlap, although people may use
the same place differently. In a public park, teenagers
might practise skating while older visitors take a gentle
walk. Facilities with comfortable seating, toilets and safe
paths can attract both groups, so age doesn't
automatically determine which places someone will use.
两者有不少重合，只是使用同一个地方的方式可能不同。在
公园里，青少年可能练滑板，老年游客则慢慢散步。座椅舒
适、有厕所和安全步道的设施能同时吸引两类人，所以年龄
并不直接决定一个人会去哪里。
a gentle walk 轻松缓慢的散步
5. Are newly built public facilities necessarily better
than older ones?
新建的公共设施一定比旧的更好吗？ 用设备新旧与到达便利
的区别，说明真正好用还要看维护。
Not necessarily. A new sports centre may have
impressive equipment, but it isn't very useful if people
can't reach it easily. An older neighbourhood pool could
serve residents better because it's affordable and close to
their homes. I'd judge a facility by its condition,
accessibility and everyday usefulness, rather than just its
age.
不一定。新体育中心可能设备出色，但如果到达不便，作用
就有限。老社区泳池可能收费适中、离家近，反而更能满足
居民需要。我会看设施的状况、可达性和日常用途，而不仅
是建成时间。
serve residents 为居民提供服务

sections.title: 喜欢拜访但不想去住的家
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
145
话题 94
PART 2
喜欢拜访但不想去住的家
A home I enjoy visiting
Describe a home you enjoy visiting but would not choose to live in.
描述一个你喜欢拜访却不想住进去的家。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. What the home is like
房子是什么样的
3. Why you enjoy visiting
你为什么喜欢拜访
4. Why you would not live there
你为什么不想住在那里
审题与选材：这道题需要同时成立的两种感受：短住舒服，长期生活不便。可以围绕亲戚的乡间小院，把做饭、聊天等拜访
乐趣讲具体，再从交通和日常采购解释不想搬去。不要把前面喜欢的理由全部推翻。
叙述顺序
A 交代姑姑家的乡间位置 - B 描写小院与厨房的样子 - C 讲述周末拜访时做的事 - D 说明长期居住面临的困难 - E 区分短
暂放松与日常需要
A Introduce my aunt’s house outside town - B Describe the courtyard and large kitchen - C Recall cooking and chatting
during visits - D Explain the practical difficulties of living - E Separate relaxing visits from daily needs
示例回答
My aunt lives in a village about an hour outside my city, and her house is one of my favourite places to spend a
Sunday. I wouldn't want to move there permanently, though. It's a simple two-storey house with a tiled
courtyard and a large kitchen at the back. There are pots of herbs near the door, and the kitchen table is big
enough for the whole family. When I visit, we usually make lunch together. My aunt gives me something easy to
do, like washing vegetables, while she tells me what's happened in the village. After lunch, we sit outside with
tea. Nobody seems particularly concerned about the time, which makes a pleasant change from my normal
week. Living there would be a different story. The nearest bus stop is a long walk away, and buses don't run very
often. I'd have trouble getting to work, especially on rainy mornings. Even buying a few ingredients would
require more planning than it does now. I also think the silence might feel lonely after several evenings. So I
love the house as somewhere to slow down and enjoy my aunt's company, but for everyday life, I'd rather have
shops, friends and reliable transport within easy reach.
中文对照：姑姑住在离我所在城市约一小时的村子，她家是我最喜欢过周日的地方之一，但我不想永久搬去。那是一栋普
通两层房子，有铺砖的小院，后面是大厨房。门口摆着香草盆栽，餐桌足够坐下全家。拜访时通常一起做午饭。姑姑让我
做洗菜这类简单的事，一边讲村里的近况。饭后我们在外面喝茶，大家好像都不在意时间，这与平日一周的节奏很不同，
也令人愉快。不过长期住是另一回事。最近的公交站要走很远，班次也少，上班会困难，雨天早晨尤其麻烦。哪怕买几样
食材，也比现在需要更多计划。连续过几个安静夜晚后，我还可能觉得孤单。所以我喜欢来这里放慢脚步、陪姑姑，但日
常生活仍希望商店、朋友和可靠交通都在附近。
自然表达
make a pleasant change
带来令人愉快的变化
within easy reach
很容易到达
slow down
放慢节奏
enjoy someone’s company
享受某人的陪伴
串题 话题 97 安静的地方
可沿用姑姑家的安静院子和喝茶场景，补充怎样认识这个地方及到访频率，把重点从居住不便转向安静带来的感受。
My aunt’s courtyard is also a quiet place where I enjoy sitting with tea during weekend visits.

建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
146
话题 94  /  喜欢拜访但不想去住的家
PART 3
1. Do people in China enjoy visiting friends or
relatives at home?
中国人喜欢去亲友家做客吗？ 亲友间走动与普通社交不同，
解释在家相聚为何更自在。
Many do, especially when visiting relatives or close
friends. A home allows people to talk for longer without
worrying about a restaurant closing or needing the table
back. That said, some younger people prefer meeting
outside because their flats are small or they don't want
their hosts to spend hours preparing food.
很多人喜欢，尤其是去亲戚或好友家。在家可以聊得更久，
不用担心餐馆打烊或催着腾桌。不过有些年轻人更愿意在外
面见面，因为公寓小，或者不想让主人花很长时间准备饭菜。
meeting outside 在外面见面
2. What do people in China usually do when visiting
someone’s home?
中国人去别人家拜访时通常做什么？ 从进门的小礼物说到共
同活动，避免把所有家庭说成一样。
Usually they chat, share a meal or have tea, and visitors
may bring fruit or a small gift. With close relatives,
people sometimes help prepare the food instead of sitting
as guests. The activities depend on the relationship:
children might play together while adults catch up on
family news around the table.
通常会聊天、一起吃饭或喝茶，客人可能带些水果或小礼物。
如果是亲近的家人，有时会帮忙做饭，而不是一直坐着当客
人。具体活动取决于关系：孩子一起玩，大人围桌聊家里的
近况。
catch up on family news 聊聊家里的近况
3. What kinds of places do people in your country
want to live in?
你们国家的人喜欢住在什么样的地方？ 把工作和家庭所需放
在地名前，解释便利如何影响选择。
People often look for somewhere convenient and
affordable, although those qualities aren't always easy to
combine. Working adults may prioritise a short
commute, while parents may want schools nearby. A
quiet neighbourhood with basic shops and public
transport can be attractive even if it isn't in the most
fashionable part of a city.
人们常想找便利又负担得起的地方，但这两点不总能兼顾。
上班族可能优先考虑通勤短，父母可能希望附近有学校。只
要安静、有基本商店和公共交通，即使不是城里最时髦的地
段，也会很吸引人。
a short commute 较短的通勤
4. How do urban homes differ from homes in the
countryside?
城市住宅与乡村住宅有什么不同？ 从土地和邻居距离讲空间
差异，再补交通带来的生活差别。
City homes are often flats with shared entrances and
neighbours on several sides, whereas rural homes may
offer more outdoor space. This changes daily life:
keeping gardening tools or drying large items can be
easier in the countryside. City residents usually gain
convenience in return, with shops and services located
closer to home.
城市住宅常是公寓，共用入口，周围紧邻其他住户；乡村住
宅可能有更多户外空间。这会改变日常生活：乡下更方便放
园艺工具或晾大件物品。城市居民则通常换来便利，商店和
服务设施离家更近。
outdoor space 户外空间

sections.title: 宜居之地
sections.titleEn: A place that would be good to live in
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
147
话题 95
PART 2
宜居之地
A place that would be good to live in
Describe somewhere you have visited that you would recommend as a place to live.
描述一个你去过并认为适合居住的地方。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. What you know about it
你了解那里哪些情况
3. What people can do there
人们在那里可以做什么
4. Why you recommend living there
你为什么推荐在那里居住
审题与选材：推荐宜居之地不能只介绍景点。先用自己住过的几天说明了解程度，再挑买菜、通勤和散步等日常细节。推荐
理由要有适用对象，也可承认工作机会尚未充分了解，这样判断更可信且符合真实见闻。
叙述顺序
A 说明探访朋友所在的社区 - B 交代实际住过几天的经历 - C 描述买菜与乘公交的便利 - D 补充河边散步等休闲活动
- E 给出适合人群和推荐理由
A Locate the neighbourhood near my friend - B Explain my short stay there recently - C Describe the shops and bus
connections - D Add walks beside the nearby river - E Recommend it for a quieter routine
示例回答
A neighbourhood on the edge of Suzhou would be my choice. I stayed with a friend there for four days last
autumn, and I remember thinking that ordinary life seemed quite manageable. It's outside the busiest tourist
streets, near a canal, with apartment buildings, small shops and a couple of public gardens. My friend showed
me the practical side of the area. There was a vegetable market ten minutes away on foot, and a bus stop just
outside her building. One morning, I went with her to buy breakfast, and the shopkeeper already knew what she
usually ordered. That small interaction made the neighbourhood feel friendly. People can walk beside the water,
exercise in the gardens or take a bus into the centre. During my stay, I borrowed my friend's spare bicycle and
explored the nearby streets. I liked being able to do something enjoyable without arranging a whole day out. I'd
recommend it to someone who wants a calmer routine but still needs city facilities. I can't say much about every
type of job available there, so anyone moving would need to check that first. But from what I saw, the area
offered a useful balance: everyday errands were easy, and there were pleasant places to relax close to home.
中文对照：我会选苏州边缘的一个社区。去年秋天我在朋友家住了四天，记得当时觉得普通日子似乎过得挺方便。它远离
最热闹的旅游街，靠近运河，有公寓、小店和几处公共花园。朋友带我了解实际生活：菜市场步行十分钟，楼外就是公交
站。有天早上一起买早餐，店主已经知道她平时点什么。这个小互动让我觉得社区很亲切。居民可以沿水边散步、去花园
锻炼，或坐公交进市中心。住在那里时，我借朋友备用的自行车探索附近街道，不用安排整天出游就能找到乐趣。我会推
荐给希望生活平静些、又需要城市设施的人。我不清楚那里各种工作的机会，搬去前还得核实。但就所见而言，这里兼顾
了两点：日常办事容易，离家很近又有令人愉快的地方可以放松。
自然表达
on the edge of
在……边缘
everyday errands
日常杂事
a calmer routine
更平静的生活节奏
on foot
步行
串题 话题 96 一个你去过喜欢上的城市
可沿用苏州的街区、运河和出行见闻，补充最初如何知道这座城，把日常便利转成自己最喜欢它的具体旅行体验。
That visit also made Suzhou one of my favourite cities, especially because ordinary activities there felt so pleasant.

建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
148
话题 95  /  宜居之地
PART 3
1. What sort of place do people usually like living in?
人们通常喜欢住在什么样的地方？ 围绕安全和生活可承受程
度，说明理想住所不等于大房子。
Most people want to feel safe and have their daily needs
within reach. That doesn't necessarily mean living in a
large house. Someone who works long hours may value
a nearby supermarket and a reliable bus more than an
extra bedroom, because those conveniences make an
ordinary weekday much less tiring.
大多数人希望住得安全，日常需要也能方便满足，这并不一
定意味着大房子。工作很久的人可能更看重附近超市和可靠
公交，而不是多一间卧室，因为这些便利能让普通工作日轻
松不少。
within reach 触手可及；方便到达
2. Why do some people want to go abroad?
为什么有些人想出国？ 区分学习工作和体验生活等目的，避
免把出国等同移民。
Their reasons vary. Some want a particular course or job,
while others simply want to experience a different way
of living. A student might spend one semester abroad to
practise a language without planning to settle there.
Going abroad can therefore be a temporary experiment
rather than a decision to leave home permanently.
原因各不相同。有些人为了特定课程或工作，有些只是想体
验不同生活。学生可能去国外读一学期练语言，并不打算定
居。因此，出国也可能是暂时尝试，而不是决定永久离开家
乡。
settle there 在那里定居
3. How do living arrangements in your country
compare with those elsewhere?
你们国家和其他国家的居住安排有什么差异？ 缩小比较范围，
谈代际同住及搬出时间，避免整个国家一概而论。
I wouldn't make a single comparison with all other
countries, but living with parents into adulthood seems
quite familiar in China. In some places, moving out for
university is more strongly expected. Housing costs and
family responsibilities matter, though, so sharing a home
can be a practical arrangement rather than a sign of
dependence.
我不会把所有其他国家一概比较，不过成年后与父母同住在
中国挺常见。有些地方更期待孩子上大学就搬出去。但房价
和家庭责任也很重要，所以共同居住可能是实际安排，不一
定表示依赖。
moving out 搬出去独立居住
4. How do older and younger people differ in where
they want to live?
老年人和年轻人对居住地点的偏好有何不同？ 把夜间活动与
医疗步行便利相比较，同时保留个体差异。
Younger adults may want easy access to jobs and places
to meet friends, whereas older people may care more
about quiet streets and nearby medical services. Still,
neither group is uniform. An older person who enjoys
theatre could prefer the city centre, while a young remote
worker might happily live somewhere much quieter.
年轻成年人可能想方便找工作、见朋友，老年人可能更在意
安静街道和附近医疗服务。但每一类人内部都不同。喜欢看
戏的老人可能更爱市中心，而远程工作的年轻人可能很乐意
住得清静。
easy access to 方便获得或前往
5. What should people do before moving somewhere
new?
搬到新地方前应做哪些准备？ 先核实总支出与真实通勤，再
用不同时段实地看房降低误判。
They should check the total cost, the journey to work and
the condition of the home before making a commitment.
Visiting at different times is useful too: a street that
seems peaceful at noon might be noisy at night. I'd also
arrange essential services early, so the first few days
aren't unnecessarily stressful.
决定搬家前，应核实总费用、上班路程和房屋状况。不同时
段去看看也有用：中午安静的街道，晚上可能很吵。我还会
提前安排基本服务，免得搬过去的头几天承受不必要的压力。
make a commitment 作出承诺或决定
6. Is deciding where to live among life’s most
important choices?
选择住在哪里算不算人生最重要的决定之一？ 说明住所同时
影响金钱时间和交往，再区分租住与长期买房。
Yes, because it affects several parts of daily life at once:
spending, travel time and contact with other people. A
cheaper home can become a poor choice if the commute
leaves someone exhausted. The decision is especially
important when buying, although renting gives people
more room to change their minds after trying an area.
算，因为它同时影响开支、出行时间和人际交往。便宜的住
处如果让人通勤到筋疲力尽，也可能不是好选择。买房时这
个决定尤其重要；租房则让人试住一个地区后，更有余地改
变想法。
change their minds 改变想法

sections.title: 一个你去过喜欢上的城市
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
149
话题 96
PART 2
一个你去过喜欢上的城市
My favourite city to visit
Describe the city you like best among those you have visited.
描述你去过的城市中最喜欢的一座。
1. Where it is
城市在哪里
2. How you first heard about it
你最初怎样知道它的
3. When you visited
你何时去过
4. Why it is your favourite city
它为什么是你最喜欢的城市
审题与选材：喜欢一座城市可以从旅行节奏来解释，不必堆砌地标。先交代怎样认识这座城和到访时间，再选择一个早晨与
一次偶遇来展示感受。最后说明为何它适合自己的旅行方式，让最喜欢有清楚的个人依据。
叙述顺序
A 指出成都的位置和初印象 - B 讲清朋友介绍及到访时间 - C 描述早晨散步买早餐的事 - D 回忆雨中茶馆里的小插曲
- E 解释自在节奏为何最合心意
A Introduce Chengdu and my first impression - B Explain the recommendation and visit timing - C Describe a walk and
simple breakfast - D Recall sheltering from rain with tea - E Connect the pace to my preferences
示例回答
Chengdu is probably my favourite city I've visited. It's in southwestern China, and I first became curious about it
through a college friend who grew up there. She talked less about famous attractions and more about the little
places where she liked eating and spending time. I finally went for a long weekend last spring. What I enjoyed
most was how easy it was to have a good day without doing very much. On my first morning, I walked through
a residential area, bought a warm breakfast and sat in a small public square. People were going about their
ordinary routines, and I didn't feel pressured to rush to the next attraction. Later, it started raining, so my friend
and I went into a neighbourhood teahouse. We stayed for nearly two hours, talking and watching the rain
through an open doorway. The owner brought us more hot water without making us feel we had to order
something else. Of course, I only saw a small part of the city, and I'm sure working there would feel different
from visiting. Still, it suited the way I like to travel: walking, eating simple food and leaving room for
unexpected stops. That's why I'd happily return, even without a long sightseeing list.
中文对照：成都大概是我去过的城市中最喜欢的一座。它在中国西南，我最早通过在那里长大的大学朋友产生兴趣。她很
少讲著名景点，更多介绍喜欢吃饭和闲坐的小地方。去年春天我终于去了一个长周末。最喜欢的是不用做很多事，也能愉
快地过一天。第一天早晨，我穿过居民区，买了热早餐，在小广场坐下。周围人照常生活，我也不觉得必须赶去下一站。
后来下雨，我和朋友进了社区茶馆，在敞开的门边看雨聊天，待了近两小时。店主给我们续热水，没有催着再点东西。当
然，我只见到了城市的一小部分，在那里工作肯定与旅游不同。但这里适合我的旅行方式：步行、吃简单食物、给临时停
留留点时间。所以没有长长的景点清单，我也愿意再去。
自然表达
go about their routines
照常进行日常活动
leave room for
为……留出余地
feel pressured to
觉得被迫去做
a long weekend
连着周末的短假
串题 话题 95 宜居之地
可保留成都的生活节奏和社区见闻，另补日常交通、购物及休闲活动，说明为何适合居住，不能只凭茶馆体验下结论。
Those relaxed neighbourhoods made me curious about everyday life there, though I would also check practical facilities.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
150
话题 96  /  一个你去过喜欢上的城市
PART 3
1. Is city or countryside life better for young people
and for older people?
城市与乡村生活分别更适合年轻人还是老年人？ 两组都要明
确回答，并用医疗和工作需求解释不能单凭年龄决定。
City life often suits young adults because jobs, education
and social activities are concentrated there. Rural life
may appeal to older people who enjoy space and quiet,
but access to healthcare can be a concern. I'd therefore
consider a person's needs and support network before
assuming that a particular age group belongs in either
place.
城市常适合年轻人，因为工作、教育和社交活动较集中。喜
欢空间与安静的老人可能向往乡村，但医疗是否方便是个问
题。因此，我会先看个人需求和身边支持，再判断哪种地方
合适，而不只按年龄分。
support network 身边的支持关系
2. How do travellers decide which city to visit?
旅行者怎样选择要去的城市？ 将兴趣与时间预算一起考虑，
用周末旅行说明筛选过程。
They usually balance what interests them with practical
limits such as cost and travel time. Someone with only a
weekend may choose a nearby city with good train
connections, even if a distant destination looks more
exciting. Recommendations help, but people also need to
check whether the activities match their own tastes and
energy levels.
人们通常会在兴趣和费用、路程等实际限制之间取舍。只有
一个周末的人，即使觉得远方更有趣，也可能选火车方便的
近邻城市。推荐有帮助，但还得看活动是否符合自己的喜好
和精力。
practical limits 实际限制
3. Can a city popular with tourists also be a good
place to live?
热门旅游城市也会是好的居住地吗？ 把游客享受的公共设施
与居民承担的拥挤和费用分别讲清。
It can, particularly if tourism supports good transport,
cultural activities and attractive public spaces. Residents
may enjoy those benefits all year. The difficulty is that
busy visitor areas can also become expensive and
crowded. A neighbourhood away from the main
attractions might offer the best balance between
everyday comfort and access to interesting things.
可以，尤其旅游带来良好交通、文化活动和宜人的公共空间
时，居民全年都能受益。困难是游客多的区域也可能昂贵又
拥挤。离主要景点稍远的社区，或许能兼顾日常舒适与享受
丰富活动。
offer the best balance 提供较好的平衡
4. Do travellers tend to favour modern cities or
historic ones?
旅行者通常偏爱现代城市还是历史城市？ 不假定多数人的统
一偏好，用不同旅行目的解释两类城市的吸引力。
I don't think there's one clear preference, because people
travel for different reasons. Historic cities attract visitors
who want old streets, local stories and distinctive
buildings. Modern cities appeal to people interested in
shopping, entertainment or new architecture. Many
travellers actually enjoy destinations that combine both,
so they don't have to make that choice.
我觉得没有统一偏好，因为出行目的不同。历史城市吸引想
看老街、听当地故事和欣赏特色建筑的人；现代城市吸引喜
欢购物、娱乐或新建筑的人。很多旅行者其实喜欢两者兼有
的目的地，就不用二选一。
distinctive buildings 有特色的建筑

sections.title: 安静的地方
sections.titleEn: A quiet place I return to
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
151
话题 97
PART 2
安静的地方
A quiet place I return to
Describe a peaceful place you enjoy going to.
描述一个你喜欢去的安静地方。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. How you discovered it
你怎样发现它的
3. How often you visit
你多久去一次
4. How you feel there
你在那里有什么感受
审题与选材：安静不只是没有声音，也可以是声音柔和、没人催促。先说明地方和发现经过，再交代真实的到访频率。用一
次坐着读书的过程表现情绪变化，把去前心烦、离开时放松的差别讲出来，比重复说舒服更具体。
叙述顺序
A 介绍社区花园后面的长椅 - B 回忆偶然发现这个地方时 - C 说明每月去两三次的习惯 - D 描述读书和观察光影的过程
- E 对比到达前后心情的变化
A Locate a bench behind our garden - B Recall finding it on a walk - C Explain my visits each month there - D Describe
reading and watching shifting sunlight - E Compare my mood before and afterwards
示例回答
There's a bench behind our community garden where I go when I want a bit of peace. It's only a fifteen-minute
walk from my flat, but a row of trees separates it from the road, so it feels surprisingly removed from the traffic.
I found it by accident while taking a different route home one evening. I go there two or three times a month,
usually on Sunday mornings. It's not completely silent. I can hear birds, leaves moving and occasionally
someone watering the plants. Those sounds don't bother me because they aren't demanding my attention. I
normally bring a book, although I don't always read much. Last time, I'd spent the whole week looking at
messages and unfinished tasks on my phone. I put the phone in my bag and sat watching patches of sunlight
move across the path. After a while, I stopped mentally listing everything I needed to do. What I like is that the
place gives me a short pause without requiring any special preparation or expense. I don't need to travel far or
buy a drink to sit down. By the time I walk home, I usually feel less rushed and more willing to deal with the rest
of the day.
中文对照：社区花园后面有张长椅，我想清静一下时就去。那里离公寓步行十五分钟，一排树把它与马路隔开，感觉离车
流远得出奇。我是某晚换条路线回家时偶然发现的。每月去两三次，通常在周日上午。那里并非完全无声，能听见鸟叫、
树叶动的声音，偶尔有人给植物浇水。但这些声音不打扰我，因为不会不停要求我关注。我通常带书，却不一定看很多。
上次去前，我整周盯着手机里的消息和未完成任务。于是把手机收进包，看阳光的光斑在小路上移动。过了一会儿，我不
再心里列所有待办事项。我喜欢这里能给我短暂停顿，不用特别准备或花钱，也不用远行或买饮料才能坐下。走回家时，
我通常没那么匆忙，也更愿意处理当天余下的事情。
自然表达
by accident
偶然地
demand my attention
要求我关注
a bit of peace
片刻安宁
feel less rushed
觉得不那么匆忙
串题 话题 101 自然之地
可保留社区花园及发现经过，把长椅附近的树木、鸟声和光影写具体，再说明为什么喜欢接近这些自然景物而去。
The garden also gives me a small natural space where I can watch birds and notice changing light.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
152
话题 97  /  安静的地方
PART 3
1. How easy is it to find peaceful places in your
country, and why?
在你们国家容易找到安静的地方吗？为什么？ 按地区与时间
区分，同一公园也可能因早晚不同而改变。
It depends on the location and the time of day. In busy
city centres, traffic and construction can make quiet
spaces harder to find. Even there, though, a library or a
park early in the morning may be peaceful. Smaller
towns and rural areas generally offer more options away
from constant street noise.
这取决于地点和时间。在繁忙市中心，交通和施工让安静空
间较难找。但即便如此，图书馆或清晨的公园也可能很清静。
小城镇和乡村通常有更多选择，能避开持续的街道噪音。
constant street noise 持续的街道噪音
2. How do people in your country use their free time?
你们国家的人怎样度过休闲时间？ 同时给出居家与外出的具
体活动，用可用时间长短解释选择差异。
There is plenty of variety. Some people watch shows or
play games at home, while others meet friends, exercise
or take short trips. The amount of free time matters: after
work, someone may only manage a brief walk, whereas
a free weekend allows them to plan an outing with the
whole family.
选择非常多。有些人在家看节目或玩游戏，有些出去见朋友、
运动或短途出游。空闲时间有多少也很重要：下班后可能只
能短暂散步，而周末有空就能安排全家一起出门。
plan an outing 安排一次外出活动
3. How has technology changed people’s leisure
activities?
科技怎样改变了人们的休闲活动？ 既说线上娱乐触手可及，
也说工具怎样帮助线下活动实现。
It makes entertainment available almost anywhere, so
people can fill a short break with music or a video. It
also helps them organise offline activities, such as
finding a walking route or booking a sports court. The
downside is that easy access can turn a planned
ten-minute break into an hour of scrolling.
科技让人几乎随时随地都能娱乐，短暂休息也可以听歌或看
视频。它还帮助安排线下活动，例如找步行路线或预订球场。
缺点是太容易使用，本来计划休息十分钟，最后可能刷了一
小时。
fill a short break 填充短暂的休息时间
4. Is leisure time something only older people have?
只有老年人才有休闲时间吗？ 直接否定年龄决定论，再比较
退休老人和忙碌照护者的情况。
No, people of all ages can have leisure time, although the
amount and timing differ. A student may have free
evenings, while a retired person might be busy caring for
grandchildren. Work schedules, family duties and
personal choices often matter more than age when
deciding whether someone has time to relax or pursue an
interest.
不是，各个年龄都可能有休闲时间，只是多少和时间段不同。
学生晚上可能有空，退休者却可能忙着照顾孙辈。一个人能
否放松或发展兴趣，往往更取决于工作安排、家庭责任和个
人选择，而非年龄。
family duties 家庭责任
5. Why might older people favour quiet
neighbourhoods?
老年人为什么可能更喜欢安静的社区？ 将休息和听清谈话联
系起来，不把所有老人都说成怕热闹。
Quiet surroundings can make it easier to rest and hold a
conversation without competing with traffic or loud
music. For someone who spends more time at home,
those everyday conditions matter a lot. Still, many older
people enjoy lively social spaces; they may simply want
the option of returning to a peaceful home afterwards.
安静环境让人更容易休息和交谈，不必和车流声或响亮音乐
较劲。常待在家的人会很看重这些日常条件。不过许多老人
也喜欢热闹社交，只是希望结束后能回到清静的家。
quiet surroundings 安静的周围环境
6. Why might homes be noisier now than they used to
be?
为什么现在家中可能比以前更吵？ 以设备同时运行解释声源
增加，同时说明这不是每个家庭的变化。
In some homes, there are simply more devices running at
once. A television, washing machine and several phones
can create a constant background of sound. Smaller
shared living spaces may make that more noticeable. But
it isn't true everywhere, since quieter appliances and
better windows can also make a modern home more
peaceful.
有些家只是同时运转的设备更多了。电视、洗衣机和几部手
机会形成持续背景声，共用空间较小又让声音更明显。但并
非到处如此，较安静的电器和更好的窗户，也能让现代住宅
更清静。
running at once 同时运转

sections.title: 一个你觉得吵闹的地方
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
153
话题 98
PART 2
一个你觉得吵闹的地方
A noisy place I know
Describe a place you find noisy.
描述一个你觉得吵闹的地方。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. When you normally go there
你通常什么时候去
3. What noises you hear
你能听见什么声音
4. How you feel about the place
你对这个地方有什么感受
审题与选材：选熟悉的市场或餐饮区，容易清楚交代常去时间与不同声源。不要只说声音大，可以描述自己如何提高音量、
缩短停留时间。感受也不必完全负面：喜欢食物和人气，同时不适合长待，能形成自然细节。
叙述顺序
A 定位地铁站旁边的夜市 - B 交代周五下班后常去的习惯 - C 分清叫卖音乐和做饭声音 - D 讲述听不清朋友说话的瞬间
- E 说明喜欢食物却不愿久留
A Locate the market beside the station - B Explain my usual Friday evening visits - C Separate cooking sounds from loud
music - D Recall struggling to hear my friend - E Explain my mixed feelings about visiting
示例回答
The night market beside my nearest underground station is definitely a noisy place. I usually go there on Friday
evenings, when I don't feel like cooking after work. It's a short row of food stalls under bright signs, with tables
squeezed into the space between them. There are several layers of noise. Vendors call out orders, metal pans hit
the cookers, and two or three stalls play different songs at the same time. On top of that, people are talking
across tables and delivery riders are arriving to collect food. None of those sounds is especially strange on its
own, but together they can be quite tiring. Last month, I went with a friend and we tried to catch up over
noodles. I asked her to repeat something three times before we both gave up and laughed. We finished eating
and continued our conversation while walking along a quieter street nearby. I have mixed feelings about the
market. The food is affordable, and the busy atmosphere can be fun when I'm in the right mood. But I wouldn't
choose it for a long conversation or go there with a headache. These days, I usually buy something to take away,
which lets me enjoy the food without staying in the noise for too long.
中文对照：离我最近的地铁站旁有个夜市，确实很吵。我通常周五晚上下班后不想做饭时去。那里是一排亮招牌下的摊位，
桌子挤在摊位间的空地。噪声有好几层：摊主喊单、金属锅碰炉灶，还有两三家同时播放不同歌曲。加上隔桌聊天和来取
餐的骑手，每种声音单独都不奇怪，合在一起听，就会让人觉得相当疲惫。上个月我和朋友去吃面叙旧。我连续三次请她
重复一句话，最后两人放弃并笑起来。我们吃完，一边沿附近较安静的街道散步，一边继续刚才的聊天。我对夜市感受复
杂：食物便宜，心情合适时繁忙气氛也有趣。但我不会选它长谈，头疼时也不想去。现在通常买点东西带走，既能享受喜
欢的食物，又不用在噪声里停留太久。
自然表达
call out orders
大声报单
have mixed feelings
感受复杂
take away
打包带走
catch up over noodles
边吃面边聊近况
串题 话题 99 拥挤的地方
可沿用夜市与朋友吃面的那次经历，补清时间及同行者，把重点转向桌位拥挤、行动受阻和你们怎样调整活动。
The market was also crowded that evening, so finding enough space to sit together became part of the experience.

话题 98  /  一个你觉得吵闹的地方
PART 3
1. Would you rather be somewhere noisy or quiet,
and why?
你更愿意待在吵闹还是安静的环境？为什么？ 明确个人默认
偏好，再用活动目的解释何时可以接受热闹。
I usually prefer a quiet environment because I can think
clearly and talk without raising my voice. That matters
when I'm studying or meeting a friend for a proper
conversation. I don't mind noise at a celebration or a live
performance, though, because in those situations the
shared excitement is part of the attraction.
我通常喜欢安静环境，因为能清楚思考、交谈时不必提高声
音。学习或认真与朋友聊天时，这很重要。但庆祝活动或现
场演出中的喧闹我不介意，因为那些场合共同的兴奋本就是
吸引力之一。
raise my voice 提高说话音量
2. What makes some places especially noisy?
是什么让一些地方特别吵？ 把声源密集和声音反射联系起来，
解释为何室内食堂更明显。
Often there are many activities competing in a small
space. In a busy food court, people talk, machines run
and shops play music, so everyone raises their voice to
be heard. Hard floors and walls can make the sound
carry further. Good layout and softer surfaces can
sometimes help without requiring complete silence.
通常是很多活动挤在狭小空间。热闹的美食广场里人们交谈、
机器运转、店铺放音乐，大家为让别人听见又提高音量。硬
地面和墙壁会让声音传得更远。合理布局和较柔软的表面有
时就能改善，不必完全无声。
raise their voice 提高说话音量
3. Why can a peaceful place make self-reflection
easier?
安静的地方为什么能让人更容易反思自己？ 说明外界打断减
少后如何把事情想完整，而非只说有助放松。
A peaceful place removes some of the interruptions that
keep pulling attention outward. People can follow a
thought long enough to understand what bothered them
or what they want to change. For example, after an
argument, a quiet walk may help someone separate the
actual problem from the angry things said in the
moment.
清静之处减少了不断把注意力拉向外界的打扰。人能把一个
想法持续想下去，弄清困扰或想改变的事。例如争吵后安静
散步，可能帮助人把真正的问题和当时气头上说的话区分开。
in the moment 在当时那一刻
4. How does noise influence everyday life?
噪声怎样影响日常生活？ 选休息和交流两个直接结果，用重
复说话说明小影响也会累积。
Noise can interrupt rest, make concentration harder and
turn simple conversations into an effort. Someone
working beside a renovation project may keep losing
their train of thought, while a family near a busy road
may need to close the windows. Even when each
interruption is small, dealing with it all day can become
frustrating.
噪声会打断休息、妨碍专注，让简单交谈也费劲。在装修工
程旁工作的人可能不断思路中断，住在繁忙道路旁的家庭可
能只能关窗。每次打扰即使很小，整天应付也会让人烦躁。
lose their train of thought 思路被打断
5. How can public authorities reduce unwanted
noise?
政府可以怎样减少噪声污染？ 把施工时段和交通措施对应具
体声源，并说明执行比标语重要。
They can set sensible hours for construction, control
unnecessary horn use and keep noisy activities away
from homes where possible. Rules also need a clear way
for residents to report repeated problems. For example, a
limit on late-night building work means little unless
complaints lead to an actual inspection and action when
needed.
可以合理规定施工时段、限制不必要鸣笛，并尽量让嘈杂活
动远离住宅。居民也需要明确渠道举报反复发生的问题。例
如，限制深夜施工的规定，如果投诉后没有实地检查和必要
处理，就没多大意义。
late-night building work 深夜建筑施工

sections.title: 拥挤的地方
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
155
话题 99
PART 2
拥挤的地方
A crowded place I visited
Describe a place you visited when it was crowded.
描述一个你去过的拥挤地方。
1. Where it was
它在哪里
2. When you visited
你什么时候去的
3. Who was with you
你和谁一起去
4. What you did
你在那里做了什么
5. How you felt about the experience
你对这次经历有什么感受
审题与选材：五个提示可以直接对应五步路线。拥挤要通过移动困难、排队或临时改计划来表现，而不是只报人数。把同行
的人与做过的事交织进经历中，结尾可同时保留节日气氛带来的快乐以及体力上的疲惫。
叙述顺序
A 交代河边灯会的地点时间 - B 说明与妹妹一起去看的原因 - C 描述人群中缓慢移动的情况 - D 讲清拍照买点心与提前离
开 - E 总结开心但疲惫的真实感受
A Introduce the riverside lantern event timing - B Explain why my sister came along - C Describe moving slowly through
the crowd - D Recall photos snacks and leaving early - E Balance the enjoyment against feeling tired
示例回答
Last winter, my sister and I visited a lantern display along the river in our city. We went on a Saturday evening
because we'd seen pictures of the lights and thought it would be a nice way to spend an hour together. We
clearly weren't the only people with that idea. The entrance was already packed when we arrived. Once we were
inside, we had to move at the same slow pace as everyone else. My sister kept one hand on my sleeve so we
wouldn't get separated. There were enormous illuminated fish above the path, but it was difficult to stop and
look properly without blocking someone. We managed to take a few photos from a wider part of the walkway.
Then we queued for warm rice cakes from a stall. Eating them beside the river was probably my favourite
moment, because we'd finally found enough space to stand comfortably. We left earlier than planned and walked
home by a different route. I enjoyed the colours and the cheerful atmosphere, but the crowd made the evening
more tiring than I'd expected. If I went again, I'd choose a weekday and arrive earlier. I still remember it fondly,
mainly because my sister and I laughed about our very slow journey through the lights.
中文对照：去年冬天，我和妹妹去城里河边看灯会。看了灯光照片后，我们觉得周六晚上一起逛一小时不错，显然很多人
都这么想。到达时入口已经挤满人，进去后只能与其他人一样慢慢移动。妹妹一只手抓着我的袖子，怕走散。小路上方挂
着巨大鱼灯，却很难停下细看又不挡人。我们在步道较宽处拍了几张照片，然后排队从摊位买热年糕。在河边吃的时候终
于有足够空间舒服地站着，大概是我最喜欢的片刻。我们比计划提前离开，换一条路走回家。我喜欢灯光颜色和欢乐气氛，
但人群让这一晚比预想更累。再去的话，我会选工作日并早点到。不过回想起来仍开心，主要因为我和妹妹一直拿穿过灯
会时缓慢的行进速度开玩笑。
自然表达
get separated
走散
earlier than planned
比计划更早
at the same slow pace
以同样缓慢的速度
remember it fondly
愉快地回忆这件事
串题 话题 98 一个你觉得吵闹的地方
可保留灯会地点和活动，但需补充真实听见的声源及通常何时去，不能只因那一次人多就推断那里一向很吵。
The same setting could work if I describe the sounds I heard and when I normally visit.

建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
156
话题 99  /  拥挤的地方
PART 3
1. Which cities in your country feel especially
overcrowded?
你们国家哪些城市显得特别拥挤？ 给出熟悉的大城市例子，
限定在通勤区域和时段以免夸大。
Large cities such as Beijing and Shanghai can feel
especially crowded around major stations and business
districts. I wouldn't describe every neighbourhood that
way, though. The pressure is often most obvious during
commuting hours, when many people need the same
trains and roads at once, rather than throughout the
whole city all day.
北京、上海这样的大城市，在主要车站和商务区附近会显得
特别拥挤。不过我不会说所有社区都如此。拥挤通常在通勤
时段最明显，许多人同时需要同一班车和同一条路，并非整
座城市全天都挤。
commuting hours 通勤时段
2. Will cities have more or fewer green areas in the
future?
未来城市的绿地会更多还是更少？ 表达有条件的预测，用小
型绿地说明空间不足时仍能改善。
I hope they will have more, but that depends on what
planners protect when land becomes expensive. Large
new parks may be difficult to create in dense areas, while
small gardens, planted rooftops and greener streets are
more achievable. Cities could become noticeably greener
without every improvement requiring a huge empty
piece of land.
我希望更多，但这取决于土地昂贵时规划者保护什么。人口
密集区很难新建大公园，小花园、屋顶种植和街道绿化则更
容易实现。并非每次改善都要一大片空地，城市也可以明显
变绿。
dense areas 人口或建筑密集的地区
3. Will urban residents cycle more or less often in the
future?
未来城市居民骑自行车会更频繁还是更少？ 预测要落在车道
和停车条件，解释短途骑行如何成为选择。
I think cycling could become more common for short
journeys if cities provide safe lanes and convenient
parking. People are unlikely to cycle regularly if they
have to compete with fast traffic the whole way. Weather
and distance will still matter, so bicycles will probably
complement buses and trains rather than replace them
completely.
如果城市提供安全车道和便利停车，我觉得短途骑行会更普
遍。若全程都要与高速车流争路，人们就不太会经常骑。天
气和距离仍重要，所以自行车大概会补充公交和火车，而不
是完全替代它们。
short journeys 短途出行
4. Why do people choose to visit crowded places?
人们为什么会去拥挤的地方？ 分清主动追求气氛和为了必要
服务而接受拥挤这两种原因。
Sometimes the attraction is the shared atmosphere, as at
a festival or a concert. At other times, crowds are simply
the price of getting something people need, such as
shopping at a convenient market. A place being crowded
doesn't mean everyone enjoys the crowd; they may think
the activity is still worth the inconvenience.
有时吸引力就在共同的气氛，例如节庆或演唱会。另一些时
候，人群只是获得所需东西的代价，比如去便利市场采购。
拥挤不代表所有人都喜欢人多，他们可能只是觉得活动值得
忍受不便。
worth the inconvenience 值得忍受这点不便
5. Is the continuing expansion of big cities a good
development?
大城市持续扩张是好趋势吗？ 先给条件判断，再把工作集中
带来的便利与住房压力相比较。
It can be positive if jobs, housing and public services
grow together. Larger cities can bring people closer to
opportunities and support efficient transport. But
expansion becomes a problem when affordable homes
and schools can't keep up. I'd judge the result by
residents' daily lives, rather than treating a bigger
population as success by itself.
如果工作、住房和公共服务共同增加，可以是好事。大城市
让人更接近机会，也能支持高效交通。但当可负担住房和学
校跟不上时，扩张就成了问题。我会看居民的日常生活，而
不是把人口更多本身当成成功。
keep up 跟上进度或需求

sections.title: 无聊的地方
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
建筑、居住与城市体验
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
157
话题 100
PART 2
无聊的地方
A place I found boring
Describe a place that you found boring.
描述一个你觉得无聊的地方。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. Who went with you
你和谁一起去
3. What you did there
你在那里做了什么
4. Why you found it boring
你为什么觉得它无聊
审题与选材：无聊应解释为自己的期待与实际体验不合，而不是笼统贬低整个地方。用一次陪家人办事的经历交代同行者、
做过的事和等待过程，再说明内容重复、无法参与怎样让时间变慢，结尾可以承认别人有不同需要。
叙述顺序
A 说明郊区家具卖场的位置 - B 交代陪父母挑沙发的目的 - C 讲清反复看款式和等待过程 - D 描述没有参与感导致的无聊
- E 承认卖场对购买者仍有用处
A Locate the furniture centre outside town - B Explain accompanying my parents to shop - C Describe repeated displays
and long discussions - D Show why I felt little involvement - E Recognise its usefulness for actual buyers
示例回答
A furniture centre on the outskirts of my city is somewhere I found really boring. I went there with my parents
last summer because they wanted a new sofa. They asked me to come along and help choose a colour, and I
imagined we'd be finished in about an hour. The building was huge, with several floors of sofas, tables and beds.
At first, I enjoyed sitting on different chairs and looking at the room displays. After the first few shops, though,
everything began to look rather similar. My parents carefully compared materials and delivery arrangements,
which was sensible, but I had very little to contribute. I spent a long time standing beside sofas while
salespeople explained details I didn't understand. There were no windows in that part of the building, and the
same quiet music seemed to repeat endlessly. I checked my phone, walked around a little and eventually found a
bench near the lift. We stayed for almost three hours and didn't buy anything that day. I understand why my
parents needed to take their time, but the place offered me nothing to get involved in once I'd given my opinion
about the colour. I'd happily help them choose from a few pictures next time, rather than repeat the whole visit.
中文对照：我觉得城郊的一家家具卖场很无聊。去年夏天父母想换沙发，让我陪着帮选颜色。我原以为一小时就结束。楼
很大，几层都摆着沙发、桌子和床。起初试坐不同椅子、看房间展示还挺有趣，但逛了前几家后，东西看着都差不多。父
母认真比较材质和送货安排，这很合理，可我没什么意见可补充。我长时间站在沙发旁，听销售讲我不懂的细节。那片区
域没有窗，同一段轻音乐似乎无休止地重复。我看看手机，走动一会儿，最终在电梯边找到长椅。我们待了近三小时，当
天却什么也没买。我理解父母需要慢慢选，只是说完颜色意见后，这个地方就没有什么可让我参与的了。下次我很愿意从
几张照片里帮他们选择，而不是再完整地逛上一遍。
自然表达
come along
一起去
take their time
慢慢来
get involved in
参与其中
have little to contribute
没什么可以补充的

可沿用家具卖场的销售讲解，明确销售人员讲了什么，以及自己为何继续听，把重点从环境无聊转为那段交谈。
At the furniture centre, I also listened to a salesperson even though the technical details did not interest me.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
158
话题 100  /  无聊的地方
PART 3
1. Why do most children find education dull?
为什么大多数孩子觉得学习很无聊？ 不接受所有孩子都无聊
的前提，集中解释重复和缺乏用途。
Not all children do, but lessons can feel dull when they
involve repeating information without understanding its
purpose. Children may struggle to see why a rule matters
until they use it themselves. For example, measuring a
real classroom can make a maths lesson more engaging
than copying the same calculation from the board
repeatedly.
并非所有孩子都如此，不过反复记信息却不懂用途时，课堂
容易无聊。孩子可能要亲自用到一条规则，才理解它为何重
要。例如实际测量教室，比反复照抄黑板上同样的算式，更
能让数学课吸引人。
see why it matters 理解它为什么重要
2. Why might young people resist hearing older
people’s experiences?
年轻人为什么可能不愿听长辈谈经历？ 指出拒绝的可能是训
话方式，用讲选择和错误替代单向说教。
They may feel that the story is turning into a lecture or
that their own circumstances are being ignored. Advice
about finding work decades ago may not seem directly
useful now. Older speakers can make their experiences
more relevant by explaining a difficult choice or
mistake, then listening to what the younger person is
facing.
他们可能觉得故事变成了训话，或者自己的处境被忽略。几
十年前找工作的建议，如今未必直接适用。长辈可以讲一次
困难选择或错误，再听听年轻人正在面对什么，让自己的经
历更有意义。
turn into a lecture 变成一番说教
3. What can someone do to deal with boredom?
感到无聊时可以做什么？ 先判断是需要休息还是缺少挑战，
再给一个容易开始的活动。
It helps to work out whether they need rest or a fresh
challenge. If they've been sitting indoors all day, a short
walk or a simple practical task can change their mood.
They could also try a small version of something
unfamiliar, like cooking one new dish, without
committing to a whole new hobby.
先弄清自己需要休息，还是新的挑战。如果整天坐室内，短
暂散步或做件简单动手任务就可能改变心情。也可以小规模
尝试陌生事物，比如做一道新菜，不必立刻投入一个全新的
爱好。
a fresh challenge 新的挑战
4. Why are some lessons boring, and how could
teachers improve them?
为什么有些课堂无聊？教师可以怎样改进？ 同时回答原因和
办法，让单向讲授对应学生需要作出选择的任务。
Some lessons are boring because students spend too long
listening without doing anything with the information.
Teachers could break explanations into shorter sections
and give learners a problem to solve between them. A
history class, for example, could ask students to compare
two accounts and decide why the writers described the
same event differently.
有些课堂无聊，是因为学生长时间只听，却不运用信息。教
师可缩短每段讲解，中间让学生解决一个问题。例如历史课
可让学生比较两份记述，判断作者为什么对同一事件写得不
同。
break into shorter sections 分成较短的部分

sections.title: 自然之地
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
旅行计划与出行经历
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
159
话题 101
PART 2
自然之地
A natural place I enjoy
Describe a place in nature that you like.
描述一个你喜欢的自然场所。
1. Where it is
它在哪里
2. How you discovered it
你怎样知道它的
3. What it is like
它是什么样的
4. Why you enjoy going there
你为什么喜欢去那里
审题与选材：自然场所可以是近郊湿地，不一定是远方名山。位置与发现方式简要交代，把主要时间留给水面、芦苇和步道
等能看见的细节。用放慢步速观察鸟的动作说明喜欢的原因，让景物与自己的活动相连。
叙述顺序
A 定位城外公交能到的湿地 - B 说明同事听到需求后推荐 - C 描述芦苇浅水和木板步道 - D 讲述停下观察水鸟的细节
- E 解释不赶路的自然体验意义
A Locate the wetland beyond our city - B Explain a recommendation from my colleague - C Describe reeds shallow water
and paths - D Recall stopping to watch the birds - E Explain the pleasure of moving slowly
示例回答
There's a wetland area just outside my city that I really enjoy visiting. A colleague recommended it when I
mentioned wanting somewhere to walk without climbing a mountain. I can reach the entrance by bus, and from
there a wooden path leads out towards the water. The landscape is quite simple: shallow pools, tall reeds and a
few trees. It changes more than you'd expect, though. On a windy day, the reeds move together and the water
looks dark. When it's still, you can see reflections of the clouds between the plants. There are benches along the
path, but very few shops, which I quite like. The last time I went, I spent several minutes watching a small bird
step through the water. It stopped so often that I nearly walked past it, then suddenly caught something and
moved away. I couldn't identify the bird, but watching it was more interesting than trying to collect photographs
of everything. I like this place because it makes me slow down naturally. There's no particular attraction I have
to reach or activity I need to book. I can just walk, notice small changes and head home when I've had enough.
It's an easy way to spend time outdoors without turning the day into a complicated trip.
中文对照：城外有片湿地，我很喜欢去。有次我说想找个不用爬山也能散步的地方，同事便推荐了它。坐公交能到入口，
再沿木板路走向水边。景色很简单：浅水池、高芦苇和几棵树，但变化比想象中多。有风时芦苇一齐摇动，水色发暗；风
停时，植物间能看见云的倒影。路边有长椅，却很少商店，我挺喜欢这一点。上次我看一只小鸟在水里走了好几分钟。它
停得很频繁，我差点走过去，随后它突然捉到什么便走开了。我认不出鸟名，但观察它比到处拍照更有意思。这里让我自
然放慢脚步，没有必须到达的景点，也没有要预约的活动。只需走走、看细微变化，够了就回家，能轻松享受户外，不必
把一天安排成复杂旅行。
自然表达
head home
往家走
spend time outdoors
在户外度过时间
walk past
从旁边走过
small changes
细微变化
串题 话题 97 安静的地方
可保留湿地步道和观察鸟的片段，补充实际到访频率，重点写声音与心情变化，不能只用水面和芦苇描写代替安静。
The wetland is also somewhere I go for peace, with soft natural sounds instead of constant traffic.

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
160
话题 101  /  自然之地
PART 3
1. What kinds of people enjoy spending time in
nature?
哪些人喜欢去自然场所？ 从不同动机划分人群，说明自然活
动无需固定年龄或体能。
People go for different reasons. Some want exercise or a
physical challenge, while others simply need a break
from buildings and screens. Families may choose an
easy nature trail, and photographers might wait quietly in
one spot. So I wouldn't link this interest to one age group
or a particular level of fitness.
去的人目的不同：有人想锻炼或挑战体能，有人只是想暂时
离开建筑和屏幕。家庭可能选平缓自然步道，摄影爱好者则
可能静待一处。因此，我不会把这项兴趣限定在某个年龄或
体能水平。
a physical challenge 体能上的挑战
2. Can wild animals be found in cities?
城市里能找到野生动物吗？ 先区分野生与大型动物，再说明
常见鸟虫如何利用城市空间。
Yes, although people sometimes overlook them because
they imagine wild animals must be large or unusual.
Birds, insects and small mammals can live around trees,
gardens and waterways in a city. A quiet patch of
vegetation may provide food and shelter, even when
busy streets and apartment buildings are only a short
distance away.
可以，只是人们有时忽略它们，以为野生动物一定很大或罕
见。鸟、昆虫和小型哺乳动物可以生活在城市树木、花园和
水道周围。一小片安静植被也能提供食物与庇护，哪怕繁忙
街道和公寓就在附近。
food and shelter 食物与庇护
3. Should local parks keep animals for visitors to look
at?
当地公园应不应该养动物供人观看？ 区分自由栖息与为展示
而圈养，再以照护条件作判断依据。
I'd distinguish between protecting animals that naturally
live there and keeping others mainly for display. Birds
living freely around a pond are very different from an
animal confined to a small cage. If a park keeps animals,
it needs suitable space, expert care and a clear reason
beyond giving visitors something interesting to
photograph.
我会区分保护自然生活在那里的动物，和主要为了展示而饲
养其他动物。池塘边自由生活的鸟，与被关在小笼子的动物
很不同。公园若养动物，需要合适空间、专业照料，以及除
供游客拍照之外的明确理由。
live freely 自由生活
4. Do children in your country spend much time
playing outside?
你们国家的孩子经常在户外玩吗？ 承认家庭差异，用附近安
全场地和课业时间解释机会不同。
Some do, especially when they have a safe playground
nearby and adults who can accompany them. Others
spend much of their free time indoors because of
homework, limited space or busy family schedules. I
think access matters greatly: children are more likely to
play outside when getting there doesn't require a long car
journey.
有些经常玩，尤其附近有安全游乐场、也有大人陪伴。另一
些因作业多、空间少或家庭安排忙，把大部分空闲时间花在
室内。我觉得到达便利很关键，不必坐很久车才到，孩子就
更容易去户外。
a safe playground 安全的游乐场
5. How does a natural area differ from a city
environment?
自然区域与城市环境有何不同？ 比较空间由谁主导及便利程
度，同时承认城市也能包含自然。
A natural area is usually shaped more visibly by plants,
water and weather, while a city is organised around
buildings, roads and human activities. That affects the
experience: nature may offer fewer conveniences but
more room to notice seasonal changes. The boundary
isn't absolute, though, because a well-designed urban
park can contain both qualities.
自然区域通常更明显受植物、水和天气影响，城市则围绕建
筑、道路和人的活动组织。这改变体验：自然之地可能便利
较少，却更有机会观察季节变化。但界线并非绝对，设计好
的城市公园可以兼具两种特点。
seasonal changes 季节变化
6. Is visiting a park the only way to connect with
nature?
去公园是亲近自然的唯一方式吗？ 用可在日常观察的小事展
开，重点是注意自然而非远行。
No, people can notice nature in much smaller ways.
Growing herbs on a balcony, watching birds from a
window or paying attention to trees on the walk to work
all create some contact. A park offers more space, but
the important part is actually observing living things
rather than simply being somewhere labelled as natural.
不是，细小日常活动也能接近自然。阳台种香草、从窗户观
察鸟，或上班路上留意树木，都能建立联系。公园空间更大，
但重要的是实际观察生命，而非只是待在一个被叫作自然场
所的地方。
pay attention to 留意；注意

sections.title: 推荐的度假地
sections.titleEn: A place I went on holiday
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
旅行计划与出行经历
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
161
话题 102
PART 2
推荐的度假地
A place I went on holiday
Describe a place where you spent a holiday.
描述一个你去度假的地方。
1. When and where you went
你何时去了哪里
2. Who travelled with you
你和谁一起去
3. What you did there
你在那里做了什么
4. How you felt about the place
你对这个地方有什么感受
审题与选材：不要被题目简称限制成必须推荐，实际任务是描述去过的度假地和感受。时间、同行者简明交代，再选海边散
步和下雨后的替代活动展开。喜欢某地可以来自行程不紧张，而非景点数量多或消费昂贵。
叙述顺序
A 说明初夏去海边小镇度假 - B 交代和表姐坐火车出行 - C 讲述清晨海边散步的经历 - D 描述雨天改去小餐馆聊天
- E 解释轻松行程带来的满足感
A Introduce the seaside town in summer - B Explain travelling there with my cousin - C Describe our early walk beside
water - D Recall changing plans when rain arrived - E Explain why the relaxed schedule worked
示例回答
My cousin and I spent three days in a small seaside town last June. It was about two hours away by train, which
made it easy to visit without using most of the holiday just getting there. We stayed in a simple guesthouse a few
streets back from the beach. On the first morning, we went out early and walked along the shore before it
became busy. The sand was cool, and a few people were collecting shells with their children. We bought
breakfast from a little shop and ate it on a bench facing the water. It was such an ordinary activity, but having no
appointment afterwards made it feel special. We'd planned to spend the next afternoon on the beach, but it
rained. Instead, we found a small restaurant and stayed over a late lunch, talking about things we rarely had time
to discuss at home. The rain stopped eventually, and we wandered through the town without any particular
destination. I felt very comfortable there. It wasn't a dramatic or luxurious holiday, and we didn't come back
with a long list of achievements. We simply had room to rest and enjoy each other's company. For me, that was
exactly what made the place a good choice for a short break.
中文对照：去年六月，我和表姐在一个海边小镇待了三天。火车约两小时就到，所以很方便，不用把假期大半耗在赶路上。
我们住在离海滩几条街的简单客栈。第一天清晨趁人少沿海岸走，沙子凉凉的，有几个人带孩子捡贝壳。我们在小店买早
餐，坐在面朝大海的长椅上吃。活动很普通，但之后没有任何约好的事情，就显得特别。原计划第二天下午待在海滩，却
下了雨，于是找家小餐馆晚些吃午饭，慢慢聊平时在家很少有空谈的事。雨终于停了，我们没有特定目的地，随意逛小镇。
我在那里很自在。这次假期既不惊险也不奢华，回来也没有长长的成就清单，只是有余地休息、享受彼此陪伴。对我来说，
这正是它适合短暂度假的原因。
自然表达
a short break
短暂假期
wander through
漫步穿过
face the water
面朝水面
get there
到达那里
串题 话题 101 自然之地
可沿用海岸散步和清凉沙子的细节，把地点缩小到海滩，补充怎样知道那里，重心从同行度假转向自然环境的吸引力。
The beach itself would also work as a natural place, especially the quiet shore we explored before breakfast.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK

雅思口语 · 话题与表达
162
话题 102  /  推荐的度假地
PART 3
1. Is picking a holiday destination difficult for young
people?
年轻人选择度假地困难吗？ 说明选项多与预算少的冲突，并
给出先定限制的实际过程。
It can be, because they may see many attractive places
online but have limited money and time. Choosing
becomes easier once they agree on a budget and the kind
of trip they want. A group seeking rest will need
different options from friends who want nightlife, even if
everyone initially likes the same photos.
可能困难，因为网上有很多吸引人的地方，钱和时间却有限。
先商定预算和想要的旅行类型，选择会容易些。想休息的一
群人，与想体验夜生活的朋友，需要不同选项，即使最初都
喜欢同样的照片。
agree on a budget 商定预算
2. How do people decide when to travel?
人们怎样决定旅行日期？ 先谈能否请假和学校放假等硬限制，
再谈天气价格等可调整因素。
Work leave and school holidays usually set the limits
first. Within those limits, people may compare weather,
prices and how crowded a destination is likely to be.
Someone with flexible working hours might travel
during a quieter week, while a family with
schoolchildren may have much less choice, even if
another date would be cheaper.
工作假期和学校放假通常先划定范围。范围内再比较天气、
价格和预计拥挤程度。工作时间灵活的人可能选清静的一周，
有学龄孩子的家庭选择却小得多，即使其他日期便宜，也未
必能去。
flexible working hours 灵活的工作时间
3. How do older people and children differ in their
holiday preferences?
老人和孩子对度假地的偏好有什么不同？ 分别说明体力安排
与活动吸引，再用全家游寻找共同需要。
Older travellers may pay more attention to comfortable
transport, manageable walking distances and places to
rest. Children often focus on what they can do, such as
swim, play or see animals. A family holiday works best
when it includes both: interesting activities for children
and enough breaks so older relatives aren't constantly
trying to keep up.
老年旅行者可能更看重交通舒服、步行距离适中、有地方休
息。孩子常关注能做什么，比如游泳、玩耍或看动物。家庭
度假最好兼顾两者：孩子有有趣活动，长辈也有足够休息，
不必一直努力赶上。
walking distances 步行距离
4. How does weekend clothing differ from weekday
clothing?
周末穿着和工作日穿着有什么差异？ 按工作要求与周末活动
解释变化，不强行转回旅行话题。
For people with a workplace dress code, weekday
clothes are often more formal, while weekends allow
comfortable shoes and casual outfits. The difference
depends on the job and the occasion, though. Someone
who wears practical clothes at work might actually dress
more carefully on Saturday because they're going out for
a special meal.
有工作着装要求的人，平日常穿得正式些，周末可以穿舒服
鞋子和休闲服。不过差别取决于工作和场合。上班穿实用衣
服的人，周六出去吃一顿特别的饭，反而可能打扮得更认真。
a dress code 着装规定
5. How much does weather matter during a holiday?
天气对假期有多重要？ 把户外计划与室内城市游区分，说明
坏天气影响程度不同。
It matters a lot when the main activities are outdoors.
Several rainy days could seriously change a beach or
walking holiday. For a city trip with museums and
indoor attractions, the effect may be smaller. I think
checking the forecast and keeping one or two alternative
plans is more useful than expecting perfect weather
throughout.
主要活动在户外时，天气很重要。连下几天雨会明显改变海
滩或徒步假期；有博物馆和室内景点的城市游，影响可能较
小。我觉得查预报、准备一两个替代计划，比期待全程完美
天气更有用。
alternative plans 替代计划

sections.title: 自行车/摩托车/汽车旅行
sections.titleEn: A road trip I would like to take
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
旅行计划与出行经历
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
163
话题 103
PART 2
自行车/摩托车/汽车旅行
A road trip I would like to take
Describe a trip you would like to make by bicycle, motorcycle or car.
描述一次你想骑自行车、摩托车或开车进行的旅行。
1. Who you would go with
你想和谁一起去
2. Where you would go
你想去哪里
3. When you would travel
你想什么时候去
4. Why you would choose that vehicle
你为什么选择这种交通工具
审题与选材：先明确一种交通工具，再把路线和同伴需求讲一致。计划中的旅行应使用将来或假设表达，不要突然讲成既有
经历。解释自驾优势时，可围绕途中停靠和携带物品展开，同时安排适度距离，避免不切实际的冒险。
叙述顺序
A 提出与表哥进行短途自驾 - B 说明去湖边并绕行村庄 - C 选择春季一个普通的周末 - D 安排途中停靠和自带午餐
- E 解释汽车适合此次同行需求
A Propose a short drive with cousin - B Describe the lake and village route - C Choose a normal weekend in spring - D Plan
stops and a packed lunch - E Explain why a car suits us
示例回答
I'd love to take a short car trip to a lake north of my city with my cousin. We both enjoy taking photographs, but
when we travel by train, we often see interesting places through the window and can't stop. This time, I'd like the
journey itself to be part of the day. The lake is about ninety minutes away by the main road. We'd take a slower
route through a few villages on the way there, then use the direct road to come home. I'd choose an ordinary
weekend in spring, when the weather is usually comfortable enough to spend time outside. We'd still check the
forecast before leaving. My cousin has a small car, and we'd agree on a few possible stops rather than a strict
timetable. We could buy breakfast in a village, photograph the fields and have a packed lunch near the water. I'd
bring a blanket and a flask of tea. A car would suit this trip because it would let us carry those things and change
our plans easily. I wouldn't want a long drive or a packed schedule. The appeal is being able to pull over
somewhere safe, explore a little and move on when we're ready, without worrying about missing the last bus
home.
中文对照：我很想和表哥开车去城北的一个湖。我们都喜欢拍照，但坐火车时经常隔窗看到有趣地方，却不能停下。这次
希望路途本身也是一天的内容。走主路到湖边约九十分钟。去程会绕一条较慢、途经几个村庄的路线，回程走直达路。我
会选春季普通周末，天气通常适合户外，但出发前仍会查预报。表哥有辆小车，我们会商量几个可能停靠的地点，而非严
格时间表。可以在村里买早餐、拍田野，在水边吃自带午餐。我会带毯子和一保温壶茶。汽车方便携带这些东西，也方便
改计划，所以适合这趟旅行。我不想长时间开车，也不想活动排得满满的。吸引力就在于能在安全处停车、探索片刻，准
备好了再走，不用担心错过末班回家公交。
自然表达
pull over
把车停到路边
a strict timetable
严格的时间表
a packed schedule
排得很满的日程
on the way there
在去那里的路上
串题 话题 102 推荐的度假地
可以借用湖边活动和同行人的安排，但度假题要求真实完成的经历，必须另有出行时间、实际活动与感受，不能只改时态。
If I actually take this trip, the lakeside activities could later become material for describing a holiday.


25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
旅行计划与出行经历
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
164
话题 103  /  自行车/摩托车/汽车旅行
PART 3
1. Are bicycles, cars or motorcycles most popular in
your country?
你们国家自行车、汽车和摩托车哪种更受欢迎？ 不编造全国
排名，按照长短距离与地区解释观察到的用途。
Cars are very visible in many cities, especially for family
journeys, but bicycles are also useful for short local trips.
Motorcycles seem more common in some areas than
others. I wouldn't claim one national ranking without
figures, because the answer changes depending on
whether we mean ownership, daily commuting or the
number of individual journeys.
许多城市汽车很常见，尤其家庭出行，但自行车也适合本地
短途。摩托车在不同地区的常见程度不同。没有数字我不会
断言全国排名，因为答案取决于比较拥有量、日常通勤，还
是单次出行数量。
short local trips 本地短途出行
2. Does most air pollution come from vehicles?
空气污染主要来自交通工具吗？ 避免无依据的占比判断，区
分临街感受与城市总体来源。
Vehicles can be an important source, particularly near
busy roads, but I wouldn't assume they produce most
pollution everywhere. Factories, power generation and
other activities can also contribute. The main sources
vary by place, so a city needs to understand its own
problem before deciding whether traffic measures alone
will make a large enough difference.
交通工具可能是重要来源，繁忙道路附近尤其如此，但不能
假定各地污染大多都由它们产生。工厂、发电及其他活动也
可能造成污染。主要来源因地而异，城市应先了解本地情况，
再判断单靠交通措施够不够。
make a difference 带来改变
3. Do people need major changes in transport habits
to protect the environment?
为了保护环境，人们需要大幅改变出行方式吗？ 承认集体改
变重要，再解释可靠公交为何比单纯要求放弃汽车有效。
Some changes are necessary, especially where short car
journeys could easily be replaced by walking, cycling or
public transport. But asking everyone to abandon cars
immediately isn't practical. People need reliable
alternatives first. A frequent bus that reaches workplaces
on time is more likely to change habits than a campaign
telling commuters to make sacrifices.
有些改变有必要，尤其能轻易用步行、骑行或公交替代的短
途开车。但让所有人立刻不用车不现实，先得有可靠选择。
班次多、准时到单位的公交，比只宣传让通勤者牺牲，更可
能改变习惯。
reliable alternatives 可靠的替代选择
4. How do transport systems differ between cities and
rural areas?
城市和乡村交通系统有什么不同？ 用人口分布解释班次差异，
再说明农村居民为何更依赖私人车辆。
Cities can usually support more frequent buses and rail
services because many passengers travel along similar
routes. Rural homes are more spread out, so running
frequent services can be harder. That often makes a
private vehicle more useful outside cities, especially for
reaching workplaces or appointments that don't fit the
limited local bus timetable.
城市通常能支持更密集的公交和轨道服务，因为很多乘客路
线相近。乡村住宅更分散，频繁发车较难，因此城外私人车
辆常更有用，尤其工作或预约时间与有限的公交时刻不合时。
spread out 分散分布

sections.title: 你不喜欢的短途旅行
sections.text:
25-17  /  SPEAKING BOOK
旅行计划与出行经历
雅思口语 · 话题与表达
165
话题 104
PART 2
你不喜欢的短途旅行
A regular journey I dislike
Describe a short journey you make regularly but do not enjoy.
描述一段你经常进行但不喜欢的短途出行。
1. Where you go
你去哪里
2. How often you make the journey
你多久去一次
3. Why you need to go
你为什么需要去
4. Why you dislike it
你为什么不喜欢这段路程
审题与选材：这题必须是反复发生的短途出行，不能改讲一次失败的旅行。把目的地、频率和必要性先说清，再通过换乘、
等车或拥挤解释不喜欢的部分。也可区分目的地值得去与路程令人疲惫，让抱怨更准确。
叙述顺序
A 介绍每周去培训中心的行程 - B 说明为了上晚课必须前往 - C 交代路程不远却需要换车 - D 讲述雨天站台等待的烦恼
- E 区分喜欢课程与讨厌路程
A Introduce my weekly training centre journey - B Explain why the evening course matters - C Describe the short but
awkward route - D Recall waiting at an exposed stop - E Separate enjoying classes from disliking travel
示例回答
Every Tuesday evening, I travel to a training centre for a bookkeeping course. The centre is only a few
kilometres from my home, but getting there is the short journey I dislike most. I need the course for my work,
and the teacher explains things clearly, so I don't want to stop attending. The awkward part is the transport.
There isn't a direct bus from my neighbourhood, so I take one bus for three stops and then change to another.
Walking the whole way would take too long after work, especially when I'm carrying my laptop. The second
stop has almost no shelter. If it rains, everyone crowds under a narrow roof, trying to keep their bags dry.
Sometimes I can see the connecting bus leaving just as my first bus arrives. Then I have to wait again, even
though the remaining distance is quite short. By the time I reach the classroom, I sometimes feel as if I've spent
more energy travelling than I will spend studying. I try to leave a little earlier and bring something to read, but
that doesn't make the route much better. It's frustrating because I enjoy the class itself. I just wish reaching it
didn't involve so much waiting for such a modest distance.
中文对照：每周二晚上，我去培训中心上记账课。中心离家只有几公里，却是我最不喜欢的短途出行。工作需要这门课，
老师又讲得很清楚，所以我不想停学。麻烦在交通：小区没有直达公交，要先坐三站，再换另一辆。下班后全程走路会太
久，尤其还背着电脑。第二个站台几乎没有遮挡，下雨时大家挤在窄棚下，努力不让包淋湿。有时第一辆车刚到，就眼看
要换乘的车开走。虽然余下路程很短，却只能继续等。到教室时，我有时觉得赶路花的精力比接下来学习还多。我试着早
一点出发，带东西阅读，但也没让这条路线方便多少。令人烦恼的是我其实喜欢课程本身，只是希望如此短的一段路，不
必花那么多时间在等待上。
自然表达
a direct bus
直达公交车
keep their bags dry
不让包被淋湿
the remaining distance
剩余路程
stop attending
停止参加
串题 话题 125 一个浪费时间的日常活动
可保留换乘等待的细节，明确浪费的是可避免的等车时间，并解释如何少花时间，不要把必要出行和有用课程全盘否定。
The avoidable waiting between buses is the part that feels wasteful, even though the course itself is useful.
